processes.description:
Asset-Backed Securities Management (6B5)

Overview

The scope item helps you to manage asset-backed securities investments. The functionality helps you to automate labor-intensive processes, such as payment handling and accounting postings, giving you more time to focus on value-added activities. You can manage operational and accounting requirements.

The current scope covers the asset-backed securities (ABS), such as mortgage-backed securities (MBS), collateralized debt obligation (CDO) and nonmortgage ABS.

Key Process Flow

  • Create security account

  • Create security class

  • Create financial transactions

  • Process payments

  • Post to General Ledger

  • Perform period-end closing

  • Perform installment repayment

  • Monitor and report on class positions and financial transactions

Business Benefits

  • Review the financial status

  • Automate the management of asset-backed securities investments, including creation of security account, security class and financial transaction, payments, installment repayment and accounting

  • Make better operational and strategic decisions using the comprehensive reporting and analysis tools

  • Improve internal operational compliance

  • Increase your focus on value-added activities instead of on manual procedures
processes.name: Asset-Backed Securities Management

processes.description:
Assortments (3I5)

Overview

Assortments are collections of articles for the purpose of defining which articles are relevant for which sites (stores and DCs). They're required to check whether an article can be procured by a site. In addition, assortments play an important role in other processes like point-of-sale outbound communication.

Assortments can be defined in terms of assortment modules that serve as article containers. Those assortment modules can be assigned to stores later. Furthermore, articles can be assigned to distribution centers directly without visible assortment modules in-between.

As a result of listing, assortment information is made available for operational usage in procurement. As a subtask, this includes generation of article master segments if necessary. The listing process and master data generation is automatically executed once an article-site relationship is defined by the user.

Key Process Flow

  • Manage Assortment Modules app: Also manage assortment module versions

  • Assign Products to Assortment Modules app

  • Assign Stores to Assortment Modules app

  • Replace an article in assortment modules with a follow-on article

  • Adapt the assignment period of an article-assortment module assignment across all versions

  • Exclude articles from an assortment module for a specific store

  • Copy the store assortment of one store to another store

  • Assign Products to Distribution Centersapp

  • Monitor Assortment Postprocessing Errors app for issues occurring in article master data generation

Business Benefits

  • Improve merchandising FTE productivity by automating article and site assignments with self-healing error reports and business process intelligence tools

  • Reduce operations costs by providing store managers correct information on what articles they're allowed to order, store, and sell

  • Increase revenue share of new customers by allocating the right articles to the right locations to avoid later markdowns and write-offs

  • Reduce data integration costs by providing accurate data for all operational processes such as POS connectivity, procurement, and returns

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is part of a bundle that requires a license for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, retail, fashion, and vertical business and the activation of business functions. This bundle includes several scope items that need to be activated together when you activate the bundle. To request the activation of the retail bundle from SAP cloud operations, create a ticket for component XX-S4C-OPR-SRV.

As a prerequisite, configure your system using SAP Central Business Configuration as configuration environment. Projects using the Configure Your Solution configuration environment are not supported.
processes.name: Assortments

processes.description:
Audit and Inspection Management for EHS (7Z7)

Overview

This scope item supports you in conducting inspections to ensure your company's compliance with external or internal product standards and regulations. This includes an inspection questionnaire and a systematic examination by an inspector, followed by structured review and action planning by a supervisor. The process helps you identify areas of nonconformity within your organization, address the root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to ensure continuous compliance and transparency.

Key Process Flow

  • Create questionnaires or checklists to support inspections

  • Document inspection findings and categorize them by severity and impact

  • Compile and submit inspection findings

  • Review findings and determine root causes and urgency

  • Develop action plans for corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) and assign tasks to team members

  • Track CAPA implementation with monitoring tools

  • Evaluate the effectiveness of CAPAs after resolution

Business Benefits

  • Maintain compliance with internal and external operational standards

  • Identify and resolve areas of non-conformity in the company process or products

  • Improve organizational accountability through clear roles and responsibilities

  • Ensure timely problem resolution through structured CAPA processes

  • Maintain transparency and traceability of inspection outcomes

  • Promote continuous improvement and risk reduction across operations

  • Enable data-driven decisions through monitoring and performance metrics
processes.name: Audit and Inspection Management for EHS

processes.description:
Automated Invoice Settlement (2LH)

Overview

By using this process, the customer agrees with the supplier that the supplier does not submit an invoice for a purchase order or transaction. The goods receipt is settled directly, by automatically posting the invoice document on the basis of the purchase order and goods receipt. Hence a lean and robust procurement process is ensured. This process is suitable for creating settlement documents at regular intervals.

Key Process Flow

  • Manage purchase order

  • Manage goods receipt

  • Perform automated invoice settlement

Business Benefits

  • Close purchasing transactions quickly

  • Avoid communication errors

  • Eliminate price and quantity variances in invoice verification

  • Streamlined procurement processes in an efficient and cost-effective manner

  • Ensure highly automated processes

  • Reduce manual effort greatly

  • View analytical list page: Monitor purchase order items
processes.name: Automated Invoice Settlement

processes.description:
Automated Provisioning via SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (3AB)

Overview

You can achieve automated provisioning in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition based on employee events in SAP SuccessFactors. SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance performs the provisioning and supports compliance activities with automated routing of actions for approval. You can maintain rules to determine the roles to be provisioned.

Key Process Flow

  • Maintain rules for determining role assignment

  • Maintain employment information in SAP SuccessFactors

  • Approve role assignment and mitigate risks as needed

  • Provision roles automatically to the user account in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

Business Benefits

  • Save time, effort, and cost with compliant and automated role assignment across a heterogeneous landscape based on HR events

  • Mitigate access risks with embedded analytics and proactive monitoring

  • Reduce cost of user management with a streamlined, easy-to-use process and dashboard

  • Improve application security and compliance across the enterprise

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is only relevant if you would like to integrate with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance. If you request this scope item, see the set-up instructions in the SAP Signavio Process Navigator.
processes.name: Automated Provisioning via SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance

processes.description:
Automated Purchase-to-Pay with SAP Ariba Commerce Automation (J82)

Overview

By automating purchase order to invoice processing in the SAP Business Network for Procurement, you can seamlessly connect from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to your suppliers in SAP Business Network for Procurement. You can send electronic purchase orders to your suppliers using SAP Business Network for Procurement and receive electronic order confirmations, advance shipping notices, and invoices from your suppliers in SAP Business Network for Procurement in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. You can use SAP Business Network for Procurement integration in the procurement of direct or indirect materials and in the procurement of project-based services processes.

Digitized collaboration with your suppliers in SAP Business Network for Procurement supports you in speeding up procurement processes and in reducing the number of manual process steps, thereby reducing the cost of transactions with your suppliers.

The Automation of Source-to-Pay with Ariba Network (42K) scope item is the successor to Automated Purchase-to-Pay with SAP Ariba Commerce Automation (J82), leveraging SOAP APIs and SAP Cloud Integration to integrate with SAP Business Network for Procurement. Customers who haven't previously activated J82 need to activate 42K instead. Customers who have already activated J82 can continue to use it until further notification.

New functionalities will be added only to the 42K scope item. Presently, 42K does not fully cover all functionalities of J82. The existing gaps will be closed with future releases of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. Once the gaps are closed and 42K covers all of J82's functionalities, Automated Purchase-to-Pay with SAP Ariba Commerce Automation (J82) will be deprecated.

Key Process Flow

  • Send approved purchase orders electronically to the suppliers you interact with via SAP Business Network for Procurement

  • Receive digital order confirmations automatically from your suppliers

  • Process digital advance shipping notices sent by your suppliers in SAP Business Network for Procurement into inbound deliveries in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition electronically

  • Send goods receipt notices automatically to suppliers in SAP Business Network for Procurement

  • Receive invoices from suppliers in SAP Business Network for Procurement electronically

  • Update suppliers digitally in SAP Business Network for Procurement on invoice status updates

Business Benefits

  • Reduce transaction costs

  • Speed up procurement processes

  • Improve compliance

  • Reduce manual process steps and achieve 98% touchless invoice processing

  • Increase productivity of procurement and accounts payable staff
processes.name: Automated Purchase-to-Pay with SAP Ariba Commerce Automation

processes.description:
Automatic Market Rates Management (1S4)

Overview

In this process, market data is automatically imported from the currency service provided by the SAP Business Technology Platform. You can load market rates with either Refinitiv data option, or via Bring Your Own Rates (BYOR).

The Refinitiv data and BYOR options support eight different types market data, including Currency Spot Rate, Interest Rates, Forex Swap Rates, Basis Spreads, Credit Spread, FX Volatility with Moneyness, and Securities and Exchange Rate Volatilities.

You can schedule the request for current market data as a job to get the data when you need it and tailor the market data for importing to get only the market data you need.

You can also import historical market data into your system for comparison reasons.

Key Process Flow

  • Define translation table

  • Retrieve market data

Business Benefits

  • Get an accredited source of data

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

SAP Business Technology Platform (requires a separate license) is required for this integration scenario.
processes.name: Automatic Market Rates Management

processes.description:
Automation of Central Procurement Quote with SAP Business Network (5JT)

Overview

Integrate SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition and SAP Business Network through SAP Integration Suite, managed gateway for spend management and SAP Business Network. This integration gives you access to more than two million companies that can provide quotations and quick and easy supplier discovery.

Create central request for quotations (cRFQs) in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition for central procurement. You can pool purchase requisitions from connected SAP S/4HANA systems. Suppliers submit their bids through SAP Business Network Discovery. After awarding the supplier quotations in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition for central procurement, the supplier quotation generates either purchase orders or purchasing contracts in the respective connected backend system.

Key Process Flow

  • Create central request for quotations (cRFQs) in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition for central procurement by pooling purchase requisitions from connected SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition systems.

  • The cRFQs are sent to SAP Business Network and the required suppliers are notified.

  • Suppliers submit their bids through SAP Business Network Discovery.

  • The supplier quotations are sent from SAP Business Network Discovery to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition for central procurement.

  • After awarding the supplier quotations in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition for central procurement, the supplier quotation generates either purchase orders or purchasing contracts in the respective connected backend system.

Business Benefits

  • Aggregate demand by pooling requisitions created in multiple connected backend systems into one cRFQ.

  • Source the best supplier based on the aggregated demand using SAP Business Network Discovery.

  • Quick turnaround time to get the prices from suppliers.

  • Seamless creation of purchase orders and purchasing contracts in the respective connected backend system.

  • Digital collaboration with suppliers reducing manual processing steps.

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item can be activated manually, but it requires an additional license for SAP Business Network for Procurement.
processes.name: Automation of Central Procurement Quote with SAP Business Network

processes.description:
Automation of Order-to-Invoice with SAP Business Network (4A1)

Overview

Integrate SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition with SAP Business Network to simplify and automate exchanging sales documents and their follow-on messages as a supplier (SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition) with buyers through SAP Business Network.

Key Process Flow

  • Create, change, or cancel sales orders (inbound message)

  • Display sales orders (Optional)

  • Release or cancel sales orders manually if customer-expected price checks fail

  • Send purchase order (cancellation) confirmations (outbound message)

  • Create deliveries

  • Execute picking

  • Post goods issues

  • Send advance shipping notifications (ASN, outbound delivery message)

  • Create billing documents

  • Send supplier invoices (outbound message)

Business Benefits

  • Experience greater automation in exchanging sales documents with buyers from SAP Business Network.

  • Reduce time and manual effort when corresponding with buyers.

  • Increase productivity, performance, and work satisfaction of sales professionals and accounts receivable accountants.

  • Save costs for paper, postage, mailing, and records management.

  • Enable greater scalability with process efficiency gains.

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item requires an additional license for SAP Business Network.
processes.name: Automation of Order-to-Invoice with SAP Business Network

processes.description:
Overview

This scope item lets you integrate SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition with SAP Business Network for Procurement to connect with suppliers and automate purchase order and payment processing for the procurement of direct or indirect materials and project-based service processes. You can send electronic purchase orders or payment advices to your suppliers and receive electronic order confirmations, advance shipping notices, and invoices from them through SAP Business Network for Procurement.

Digitized collaboration with your suppliers in SAP Business Network for Procurement and the integrated SAP Business Network Commerce Automation helps you speed up procurement to payment processes and to reduce manual process steps, reducing the cost of transactions with your suppliers.

Key Process Flow

  • Send approved purchase orders electronically to your suppliers through SAP Business Network for Procurement
  • Receive digital order confirmations automatically from your suppliers
  • Process digital advanced shipping notifications sent by your suppliers electronically in SAP Business Network for Procurement into inbound deliveries in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition
  • Send goods receipt automatically to suppliers in SAP Business Network for Procurement
  • Receive invoices from suppliers electronically in SAP Business Network for Procurement
  • Update suppliers digitally in SAP Business Network for Procurement on invoice status updates
  • Start payment runs upon receiving supplier invoices in accounts payable in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition
  • Send payment advices to suppliers automatically through SAP Business Network for Procurement

Business Benefits

  • Reduce transaction costs
  • Speed up procurement processes
  • Improve compliance
  • Reduce manual process steps and achieve 98% touchless invoice processing
  • Increase productivity of procurement and accounts payable staff
  • Reduce inquiries about payments from suppliers
  • Increase productivity in accounts payables department

Exclude from Default Activation

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

Reason for Excluding from Default Activation

This scope item can be activated manually, but it requires an additional license for SAP Business Network for Procurement.
processes.name: Automation of Source-to-Pay with SAP Business Network

processes.description:
Automotive Supply to Customer – Inventory Management (55F)

Overview

This scope item validates the execution of an end-to-end automotive supply-to-customer process, focusing on integrated activities across procurement, production, delivery, billing, and payment, with full inventory management support.

The process begins with creating a sales scheduling agreement and maintaining forecast delivery schedules. Planning delivery schedules can be generated to smooth demand for production. Just-in-Time (JIT) calls, which include component details and requirements, can be created manually.

Components are planned and procured through material requirements planning (MRP) and purchase scheduling agreements with external suppliers. Inbound deliveries are created, goods receipts are posted, and supplier invoices are generated. MRP also generates planned orders for production. Repetitive manufacturing confirmation triggers activities like finished goods receipt, component backflush, and cost posting.

For JIT calls, production-relevant components or package units are released. Outbound deliveries to customers are created based on open quantities. After picking and packing, the goods issue is posted. Goods can be posted as consignment stock, stored at the customer location but owned by suppliers. As goods are consumed, customers send JIT delivery confirmations via the SOAP API, or a consignment issue order is created manually. Delivery confirmations are matched with existing JIT call deliveries, and once released, subsequent documents are created, and the goods issue is posted.

Deliveries can be invoiced once goods are delivered. All incoming and outgoing payments are posted, and all products in this scenario are inventory managed.

Key Process Flow

  • Create, change, and display scheduling agreements for automotive suppliers

  • Manage forecast and planning delivery schedules

  • Create, manage, and monitor Just-In-Time (JIT) calls

  • Release JIT calls to production

  • Confirm JIT calls from production

  • Monitor material coverage

  • Manage inbound deliveries

  • Perform Evaluated Receipt Settlement procedure

  • Adjust planning in planning table

  • Check range of stock coverage

  • Stage materials

  • Confirm of assembly activities and repetitive manufacturing backflush

  • Post processing of error records

  • Create delivery, execute picking, post goods issue and goods receipt

  • Execute packing automatically in Outbound Delivery

  • Manage and monitor the JIT delivery confirmation

  • Release the JIT delivery confirmation

  • Create customer consignment issue order and outbound delivery automatically

  • Create invoice

  • Post incoming and outgoing payments

Business Benefits

  • Use scheduling agreements to reduce processing times and paperwork within your enterprise

  • Manage various types of delivery schedules (forecast, Just-in-Time (JIT) and planning delivery schedules)

  • Support the business process for JIT supply to customers

  • Enable analytical capabilities to manage demand, stock, and materials

  • Search and access scheduling agreements via new Manage Scheduling Agreements apps

  • Experience simplified handling of the production process with full cost control

  • Confirm assembly activities without using production orders

  • Manage inventory of delivered products in customer consignment stock until confirmed by the customer

  • Post invoice document automatically with Evaluated Receipt Settlement

  • Process billing based on JIT delivery confirmations from customers

  • Integrate accounts payable and accounts receivable
processes.name: Automotive Supply to Customer – Inventory Management

processes.description:
Overview

With this scope item, you can analyze the average daily balances (ADB) and spot balances in real-time. You can also get a multidimensional view of your key figures.

Key Process Flow

  • Generate a report on ADB key figures such as month-to-date, quarter-to-date, and year-to-date average balances in real-time
  • Generate a report on spot balances on the prior day, current day, current month, prior month, month-to-date, quarter-to-date, and year-to-date

Business Benefits

  • Gain insight into the factors driving the ADB key figures
  • Analyze key figures in real time not only through financial statement views , but also across cost and profit center hierarchy views
  • Dissect an ADB key figure across ledger dimensions such as chart of accounts, company code, cost center, and controlling area
  • Collaborate with other team members about ADB key figures using comments
  • Access financial services dimensions such as customer country, customer industry, customer group, data source, product group, and branch (only if the scope item 5NU is active)

Exclude from Default Activation

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

Reason for Excluding from Default Activation

The activation of scope item 649 (Average Daily Balances for Banking) is restricted to Financial Services Institutions and is not included in the default activation. You can request activation by opening an SAP Support ticket under the component FI-GL-GL-ADB.

You should do this only if you use a 3-system landscape.
processes.name: Average Daily Balances for Banking

processes.description:
Bank Fee Management (2O0)

Overview

This scope item provides comprehensive functionalities in bank fee management, such as the maintenance of the bank fee conditions and monitoring and validation of the bank fees.

You start by importing the bank service billing files into the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition system. You then create, edit, or delete the bank fee calculation conditions in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition system per the agreements you have with the banks and assign them to the corresponding bank fee items. You check the bank fees in different views or dimensions and with different detail levels. You can also validate them based on the assigned conditions and set the validation status accordingly.

Key Process Flow

  • Import bank service billing files

  • Check bank fee conditions

  • Create bank fee conditions

  • Edit bank fee conditions

  • Delete bank fee conditions

  • Monitor bank fees in different views, dimensions, and detail levels

  • Assign bank fee conditions to bank fee items

  • Validate the bank fee items and set validation status accordingly

Business Benefits

  • Increase transparency on the bank fee condition agreements with the banks

  • Increase transparency on the bank fee check and validation processes

  • Increase control over the bank charge accuracy
processes.name: Bank Fee Management

processes.description:
Bank Guarantee Management – Group Ledger IFRS (2O2)

Overview

By activating parallel valuation for bank guarantee management, you can use another valuation area in addition to your operational valuation area per International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS 9) phase I (Classification and Measurement).

Key Process Flow

  • Post flows to General Ledger

Business Benefits

  • Generate all postings for the general ledger

  • Update the general ledger per IFRS 9 phase I (Classification and Measurement)
processes.name: Bank Guarantee Management – Group Ledger IFRS

processes.description:
Bank Guarantee Management – Group Ledger US GAAP (34F)

Overview

By activating parallel valuation for Bank Guarantee Management – Group Ledger US GAAP, you can use an additional valuation area besides your operational valuation area according to US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP).

Key Process Flow

  • Post flows to general ledger

Business Benefits

  • Generate all postings for the general ledger
