processes.description:
MRP Change Request Integration with SAP Business Network (65D)

Overview

In times of changing customer demands, the material planner must react regularly to changes suggested by the MRP situation (for example, already ordered purchase orders should be updated by changing the requested date or quantity). Because of the high number of orders per day addressed to many different suppliers, an automated solution is provided to negotiate the changes with the suppliers.

With the Create MRP Change Requests app, you can reschedule proposals coming from MRP, create MRP change requests, and transfer these change requests from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain, which connects suppliers with the buying organization. The supplier can decide about an answer to the request (accept, reject, or new proposal), and can send the change request answer back to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. The requests can finally be either applied or discarded. The supplier is also informed about the decision. If the requests are applied, the corresponding purchase order is automatically changed.

Key Process Flow

  • Schedule a job to create proposals from MRP rescheduling checks

  • Create MRP change requests

  • Send MRP change requests to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain

  • Handle MRP change requests in SAP Business Network for Supply Chain

  • Send back answers to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

  • Receive answers to MRP change requests

  • Apply or discard MRP change requests

  • Send final confirmation to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain

Business Benefits

  • Use an automated solution with APIs to replace interaction with suppliers by mail or phone

  • Send rescheduling information from the MRP directly to suppliers

  • Track the status for change requests

  • View additional information, such as priority, reasons, or comments

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

The scope item requires an additional license for SAP Business Network for Supply Chain.
processes.name: MRP Change Request Integration with SAP Business Network

processes.description:
My Store Management (5FW)

Overview

Store associates and managers execute processes differently than employees working in the headquarters. Complex user interfaces aren't an option for in-store processes because of costly training and higher turnover rates of store personnel. The SAP Fiori apps in this scope item are user-friendly, self-explanatory, and streamlined for in-store processes.

A dashboard that contains the most important KPIs for efficient day-to-day operations supports store associates and managers. The dashboard can be configured to exactly meet their needs.

Furthermore, store managers can maintain necessary information required to run and manage processes and people in their store. The SAP Fiori app provides the possibility to:

  • Monitor and analyze the most critical KPIs of the store

  • Maintain the staff working in the store and thereby control access to the store’s data

  • Maintain the picking sequence to support omnichannel order fulfillment (for more information, see the Omnichannel Order Fulfillment for Retail (5FZ) scope item.

Key Process Flow

  • My Store Overview app: With this overview, store managers can monitor and analyze the most important KPIs of their stores

  • Assign Employees to Stores/My Store Assignment app: Store Managers can assign the employees working in their stores or store associates can assign themselves to another store if they're helping to filter the data provided in the app

  • Maintain Picking Sequence app: Define most efficient sequence for picking of omnichannel orders

Business Benefits

  • Reduce store operating cost by giving store managers actionable insights into the most important KPIs

  • Reduce manager time on employee administration by managing employee user data efficiently

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item can only be activated if you have a license for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, retail, fashion, and vertical business and have activated the retail bundle. To request the activation of the retail bundle from SAP cloud operations, create a ticket for component XX-S4C-OPR-SRV.

As a prerequisite, configure your system using SAP Central Business Configuration as configuration environment. Projects using the Configure Your Solution configuration environment are not supported.
processes.name: My Store Management

processes.description:
Nonconformance Management (2QN)

Overview

This scope item describes the management of defects and nonconformances. The quality technician creates a defect record and if necessary, adds a picture that documents the defect. The quality engineer further processes the defect record by documenting or defining immediate, corrective, and preventive actions. The quality technician executes the defined actions and confirms processing by setting a respective status. After defect resolution, the quality engineer closes the defect record.

In addition to general defect category, a new defect category is introduced which can be used to handle defects that occur during production. That is, the assignment of production order, material, plant, and defective quantity has been enabled.

Furthermore, the quality engineer monitors and analyzes defect records from various sources (for example, defects detected during quality inspection or manually created defects) and deduces common preventive actions.

If necessary, the quality technician creates additional, manual inspection lots for the available inspection origins to perform additional quality inspections. After inspection results are captured, the quality engineer makes a usage decision to close the manual inspection process.

Key Process Flow

Manage defects:

  • Record defect

  • Process defect and define quality task

  • Execute quality task and document outcome

  • Complete defect processing

  • Record defect using SAP Co-pilot

  • Assign defect to quality notification

Manual inspection process:

  • Create inspection lot

  • Record inspection results

  • Make usage decision

Business Benefits

  • Capture defects and nonconformances for documentation and for further processing

  • Decide whether a simple defect can be managed as generic defect or must be escalated to a quality notification for comprehensive processing

  • Execute quality tasks to mitigate or resolve the defect

  • Change quality tasks and defects using mass-processing

  • Capture status of quality task

  • Evaluate the defect data comprehensively

  • Define and execute additional manual quality inspections
processes.name: Nonconformance Management

processes.description:
Occupational Health for Environment, Health, and Safety (7ZA)

Overview

This scope item supports general employee occupational healthcare in your enterprise and planning and execution of special health protocols. These include fit-for-work examinations, health surveillance, consultations, health campaigns, and more. Special surveillance is required for persons who may be exposed to chemical, physical, or biological influences at their workplace, or who perform activities that pose a health hazard. These processes help that your company always stays up to date with safety standards and compliance obligations.

Key Process Flow

  • Create and manage health centers

  • Create and manage health service providers

  • Create, maintain, and release health protocols

  • Define triggers and frequencies for health protocols

  • Maintain costs and duration for health protocols per health service provider

  • Maintain health service types to identify sequences of treatments

  • Maintain and assign health service items to perform activities like health history, consultation, medication, and so on

  • Define health protocol owners

  • Assign compliance obligations to health protocols

  • Define and assign physicians and other roles to health centers

  • Create and refine appointments for health service requests

  • Manage health service requests to process the health protocols and health service items that shall be covered

  • Monitor health center appointments

Business Benefits

  • Keep your workforce as safe as possible by following systematized processes

  • Stay compliant with health standards and regulations by defining health protocols

  • Offer health services and health protocols that support the health of your employees

  • Keep an overview on health-related appointments
processes.name: Occupational Health for Environment, Health, and Safety

processes.description:
Omnichannel Convergent Billing (1MC)

Overview

This scope item for sales billing enables billable data sent from multiple channels (internal and external) to be combined into a single customer invoice.

After receiving billable data from external channels, the system carries it forward in the form of external billing document requests.

This scope item enables the creation of billing documents in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition system by using billable data received from an external system, received from an external system and internal data from a sell-from-stock process, or received from an external system and internal data from project-based services. Billing documents can also be created by combining billable data received from an external system with data from a sell-from-stock process and a project-based services process, or using external data imported into the system from a spreadsheet file.

Key Process Flow

  • Create billing documents using external billing data

  • Create billing documents using data from Professional Services and external billing data

  • Create billing documents using data from Sell from Stock and external billing data

  • Create billing documents using data from Sell from Stock, Professional Services, and external billing data

Business Benefits

  • Reduce administrative effort of managing billing document requests from multiple streams

  • Create clear consolidated billing documents to be sent to customers

  • Provide one legal billing document for all services, subscriptions, projects, products, and expenses (including external data)
processes.name: Omnichannel Convergent Billing

processes.description:
Omnichannel Order Fulfillment for Retail (5FZ)

Overview

In today’s retail environment, retailers must account for the situation where a consumer buys merchandise online and picks it up in a store. This benefits both the consumer and the retailer. For consumers, it eliminates the risk of missed deliveries, theft of delivered items, and unnecessary shipping charges. For retailers, it's more cost-effective than home delivery and opens up opportunities for additional sales once the consumer is in the store.

This scope item describes the fulfillment of orders placed online by consumers to be picked up in the stores. Consumers can order articles using e-commerce and pick them up at a store of their choice. This is known as buy online, pick-up in store (BOPIS) or Click-and-Collect.

Two main process steps are supported: First, the process of picking the articles from the sales floor, and second, the handover of the merchandise to the consumers. To cater for requirements of different retailer’s formats, processes can be set up flexibly (for example, small fashion boutique vs. grocery retailer).

A process variant is the Click-and-Reserve, where the merchandise isn't paid using e-commerce channels, but after handover in the store.

Key Process Flow

  • Process Picking Request app

    • Select orders to pick

    • Pick articles in the most efficient order

    • Substitute articles or reduce quantity

    • Place picking requests in handover area.

  • Hand Over Orders app

    • Scan consumer’s order number

    • Discuss exceptions from the consumer order in case of under delivery or substitutions

    • Pick up order and hand it over to consumer

Business Benefits

  • Improve customer satisfaction by providing store employees with all the tools and information needed to fulfill customer orders

  • Improve store employee productivity by providing an efficient and user-intuitive application to pick and fulfill online orders

  • Improve customer satisfaction by reacting quickly to article substitutions and shortages

  • Increase revenue through executing on cross-selling opportunities while customer is in the store

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item can only be activated if you have a license for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, retail, fashion, and vertical business and have activated the retail bundle. To request the activation of the retail bundle from SAP cloud operations, create a ticket for component XX-S4C-OPR-SRV.

As a prerequisite, configure your system using SAP Central Business Configuration as configuration environment. Projects using the Configure Your Solution configuration environment are not supported.
processes.name: Omnichannel Order Fulfillment for Retail

processes.description:
Omnichannel Sales Promotion (OPPS) – Consumer Products (7T7)

Overview

SAP Omnichannel Promotion Pricing is a cloud solution that supports use across various sales channel applications, including SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. In this scenario, users can access related apps to set up rules that define eligibility criteria for omnichannel sales promotions and the associated rewards. The functionality integrates with price management and sales order management and processing. With the correct settings, the Calculation service runs each time users save a sales order or when it is manually triggered. This service verifies whether the order qualifies for promotions. If the order meets the criteria for one or more promotions, the service returns this information along with details about any free goods or discounts to be granted. The system then adds these rewards to the sales order.

You may need a separate license. For further information, contact your SAP Account Executive.

Your rule administrator can define criteria (such as the validity time frame for specific promotions, the distribution chain associated with these promotions, or the discount percentage a customer should receive). For every sales order that an internal sales representative creates, changes or when it is manually triggered the system determines if these predefined criteria are met. If so, the system grants one of the following rewards, according to what has been defined in the promotional rules:

  • Automatically creates one or more new items with free goods

  • Adapts the price data by adding a discount to one or more items or the entire sales order

Key Process Flow

  • Maintain promotion rule

  • Create sales order

Business Benefits

  • Define promotion rules in a flexible manner

  • Integrate seamlessly with the sales order management and pricing

  • Verify eligibility of orders in regards to promotion benefits

  • Grant promotion benefits during order processing

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

Omnichannel Sales Promotions is not activated by default in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition because of the following reasons:

  • Cloud Extension Model: The solution is designed as a side-by-side extension on SAP BTP, not as a core capability of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. Customers must opt-in and activate based on their business need.

  • Industry-specific set-up in pricing configuration is required.
processes.name: Omnichannel Sales Promotion (OPPS) – Consumer Products

processes.description:
Overview

This scope item enables to use of SAP Omnichannel Promotion Pricing features within a sales order in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. SAP Omnichannel Promotion Pricing is a cloud-based solution designed to operate seamlessly across multiple sales channels, including the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. It empowers rule administrators to create and manage complex promotional rules that define when promotions apply and specify the associated rewards.

These rules can be configured based on criteria such as:
  • The promotion’s valid time frame
  • Specific sales channels where the promotion is active
  • The type of discount offered, such as a percentage off

When a retail store associate creates or modifies a sales order, the system automatically evaluates whether the order meets the conditions set by these promotional rules. If the criteria are satisfied, the calculation service in SAP Omnichannel Promotion Pricing applies the rewards to the sales order automatically.

These rewards may include:
  • Free goods: Additional items are automatically added to the order
  • Discounts: Price adjustments applied to one or more items or the entire order
  • A combination of both

Key Process Flow

  • Create sales order in store and trigger SAP Omnichannel Promotion Pricing
  • Receive discounts or free goods (or both) in the sales order
  • Generate final invoice and process payment at point-of-sale

Business Benefits

  • Ensure consistent promotional pricing across all channels by providing a centralized source of truth for promotions and discounts, to maintain alignment across POS, e-commerce, call centers, and mobile platforms, delivering a seamless and unified customer experience
  • Enable real-time, dynamic pricing by calculating promotional discounts as sales orders are processed, ensuring accurate and timely pricing at the point of sale
  • Enable centralized promotion management to streamline administration and reduce ongoing maintenance efforts
  • Improve customer loyalty and revenue growth
  • Support a wide range of promotion types tailored to different customer contexts
  • Ensure seamless integration with sales and distribution processes to support efficient and consistent execution of promotions

Exclude from Default Activation

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

Reason for Excluding from Default Activation

This scope item can only be activated if you have a license for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, retail, fashion, and vertical business and have activated the retail bundle. To request the activation of the retail bundle from SAP cloud operations, create a ticket for component XX-S4C-OPR-SRV.

As a prerequisite, configure your system using SAP Central Business Configuration as configuration environment. Projects using the Configure Your Solution configuration environment are not supported.

CAUTION: Before you activate the scope item, forward the ticket to the team responsible for a technical feasibility check. Use the component LO-RFM-CNT. The team needs to confirm if the customer meets the requirements and update the ticket accordingly.
processes.name: Omnichannel Sales Promotions for Sales Orders in Retail

processes.description:
Operational and Overhead Maintenance (4WM)

Overview

Overhead maintenance allows you to record activities that aren't part of typical maintenance tasks such as training, development, documentation, and so on.

Operational maintenance allows you to record routine maintenance activities such as greasing, which is done by the maintenance or production team.

If you need to record activity that isn't reactive, proactive, or improvement in nature, you can use overhead or operational maintenance.

Overhead and operational orders support all the phases of the business process like planning, approval, preparation, scheduling, execution, post execution, and completion.

To enable safety instructions, you need to activate the scope item 54A (Health and Safety Management).

Key Process Flow

Overhead Maintenance

  • Create an overhead order

  • Plan an overhead order

  • Submit an overhead order for approval

  • Release an overhead order for preparation

  • Review maintenance backlog for readiness

  • Schedule an overhead order

  • Perform time confirmation of pre- and main maintenance order operations

  • Perform time confirmation of post maintenance order operations

  • Technically complete an overhead order

Operational Maintenance

  • Create an operational order

  • Plan an operational order

  • Submit an operational order for approval

  • Release an operational order for preparation

  • Review maintenance backlog

  • Schedule an operational order

  • Perform time confirmation of pre- and main order operations

  • Perform time confirmation of post maintenance order operations

  • Technically Complete an operational order

Business Benefits

  • Record and track activities that aren't part of traditional maintenance processes

  • Save costs

  • Keep an asset productive for longer
processes.name: Operational and Overhead Maintenance

processes.description:
Opportunity to Order with SAP Sales Cloud Version 2 (6KO)

Overview

This scope item enables the process integration of SAP Sales Cloud Version 2 with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.

After implementing the steps in the set-up instructions guide, you synchronize business partner information and replicate additional master data, such as materials, company code, and sales area data such from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to SAP Sales Cloud Version 2. Sales quotes can be created from opportunities in SAP Sales Cloud Version 2 and the follow-up document once triggered from the Sales Quote, creates a sales order in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.

Key Process Flow

  • Create or change accounts and contacts in SAP Sales Cloud and SAP Service Cloud Version 2, which are replicated to the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition and vice versa.

  • Replicate additional master data and organizational data from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to SAP Sales Cloud and SAP Service Cloud Version 2.

  • Create sales quote in SAP Sales Cloud Version 2 and trigger its follow-up sales order to be created in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.

Business Benefits

  • Reduce the total cost of ownership (TCO) by synchronizing information of front office and back-office system.

  • Enable seamless Opportunity-to-Order processing.

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item requires an additional license for SAP Sales Cloud Version 2.

Refer to the set-up instructions for guidance about available integration options. The Purpose section in the set-up instructions explains how to proceed if you are eligible for integration setup services provided by SAP.
processes.name: Opportunity to Order with SAP Sales Cloud Version 2

processes.description:
Opportunity-to-Order with SAP Cloud for Customer (1VP)

Overview

After implementing the steps in the Set up guide, you replicate master data from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to SAP Sales Cloud. You can also create or change accounts and contacts in SAP Cloud for Customer, which are replicated to the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.

In SAP Sales Cloud, you can leverage this data to create new opportunities and quotes. While doing so, prices can be calculated in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition and sent back to SAP Sales Cloud. Sales orders in SAP S/4HANA can be created as a follow-up document from the SAP Sales Cloud quote.

Once the sales order is in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, the sales order ID is sent back to SAP Sales Cloud. In the SAP Sales Cloud, you can check your sales documents for the sales order ID from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. You may open and manage the sales order by accessing the SAP S/4HANA UI from your SAP Sales Cloud system via UI mashup.

Additionally, Equipment and Functional location can be replicated in both the directions. This requires additional license for SAP Event Mesh Service on BTP.

Key Process Flow

  • Create SAP Sales Cloud opportunities and quotes leveraging SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition master data

  • Create or change accounts and contacts in SAP Sales Cloud, which are replicated to the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

  • Request prices from SAP S/4HANA within the SAP Sales Cloud opportunity and SAP Sales Cloud quote management process

  • Create sales orders in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition as follow-up document from either SAP Sales Cloud opportunity or SAP Sales Cloud quote

  • Manage sales orders in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition UI via UI mashup from SAP Sales Cloud

Business Benefits

  • Reduce the total cost of ownership (TCO) by leveraging information stored in your back-end system

  • Reduce TCO by using SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to manage processes after sales order creation
processes.name: Opportunity-to-Order with SAP Cloud for Customer

processes.description:
Overview

This scope item bridges your online storefront and back-office operations. Business customers expect the same high-level buying experience as private customers. At the same time, your organization wants to have the product data available in all channels in a consistent way without double maintenance.

Orders created and stored in SAP Commerce Cloud, cloud ERP edition are transferred to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition for order fulfillment. The order status for the sales document is replicated from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to SAP Commerce Cloud, cloud ERP edition.

In addition, relevant master data, such as products (including classification, prices, and discount), stock level, business partners, and connected contact persons are replicated from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to SAP Commerce Cloud, cloud ERP edition.

Key Process Flow

  • Create and maintain relevant master data (such as products, business partners, and pricing data) in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition
  • Replicate master data from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to SAP Commerce Cloud, cloud ERP edition using standard integration mechanisms
  • Create sales orders, considering the price and availability in SAP Commerce Cloud, cloud ERP edition by customers
  • Transfer sales orders to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition for fulfillment, including availability check, delivery creation, and billing

Business Benefits

  • Provides ready-to-use documentation and sample content to accelerate the integration of SAP Commerce Cloud, cloud ERP edition with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition
  • Supports a predefined and SAP-recommended order-to-cash process for selling physical goods from stock
  • Builds on existing, validated integration scenarios without introducing new custom code in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition
  • Consolidates customer-facing commerce processes in SAP Commerce Cloud, cloud ERP edition, while core ERP execution is handled in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

Exclude from Default Activation

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

Reason for Excluding from Default Activation

The scope item mainly delivers integration documentation and sample and demo content and doesn't provide standalone business value without an actively planned SAP Commerce Cloud, cloud ERP edition implementation.

Activation is recommended only for customers who explicitly plan and configure an SAP Commerce Cloud, cloud ERP edition integration scenario, making it unsuitable for default activation.
processes.name: Order-to-Cash with SAP Commerce Cloud, cloud ERP edition

processes.description:
Organizational Flexibility in Financial Accounting (4PG)

Overview

Generally, a management decision triggers a change to the profit center structure.

The current scope for organizational changes is designed for Professional Services customers and for all customers who use product-related business processes, such as purchasing, sales, and production.

You can define the profit center reassignment for the designated master data and business objects. The objects affected by the reorganization are reassigned and their balances are reposted to the new organizational entities.

The solution supports the reassignment of profit centers at a key date (effective date).

The solution lets you simulate an organizational change. Analytics capabilities are provided to assess the completeness of the object list and the profit center reassignment status, preview or review the transfer posting and its effect on financial KPIs, and to check the logs for the steps performed.

Key Process Flow

  • Create organizational change

  • Identify objects affected by an organizational change

  • Assign objects – List views

  • Simulate an organizational change

  • Analyze the impact on master data and profit center balances

  • Activate, process, and complete the organizational change

Business Benefits

  • Conduct organizational structure change flexibly in the profit center (financial accounting organization entity)

  • Reduce finance cost by supporting an organization's ability to perform changes in a timely manner

  • Automate master data update and account balance postings to reduce manual workload and ensure greater accuracy

  • React easily and quickly to changed internal and external situations

  • Adjust the internal controlling structure and the external reporting structure with effectiveness and efficiency

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is only relevant for you if your finance organization undergoes frequent changes (such as splitting, combining, and replacing profit centers). The current scope for this scope item is designed for Professional Services customers and for all customers who use product-related business processes, such as purchasing, sales, and production.
processes.name: Organizational Flexibility in Financial Accounting

processes.description:
Outbound Logistics for Distribution Centers (5FV)

Overview

The stock transfer order is the basis for procurement of merchandise for the store from the distribution center. The stock transfer order is a variation of the purchase order for internal procurement. A worklist item is created based on the articles, dates, and logistical parameters. An automatic process analyzes the delivery-due list and creates the relevant outbound deliveries for processing. These outbound deliveries form the basis for the logistical processes, such as picking and optional packing. On completion, the goods issue is posted with reference to the outbound delivery. Inventory is adjusted and the financial accounts are posted. A delivery note can be printed before or after posting the goods issue. For legal requirements, you may need to attach shipping documents for goods identification for physical transport.

Key Process Flow

  • Create an outbound delivery with reference to a stock transport order

  • Change outbound delivery for picking and packing (handling unit optional)

  • Post goods issue

  • Print outbound delivery as loading list (optional)

Business Benefits

  • Reduce total logistics cost by improving the efficiency of logistics execution function using well-integrated picking, packing, and shipping processes

  • Reduce order fulfillment lead time by using real-time information on timely completion of picking, packing, and shipping activities

  • Reduce transportation spend by making informed decisions based on accurate demand and supply data

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is part of a bundle that requires a license for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, retail, fashion, and vertical business and the activation of business functions. This bundle includes several scope items that need to be activated together when you activate the bundle. To request the activation of the retail bundle from SAP cloud operations, create a ticket for component XX-S4C-OPR-SRV.

As a prerequisite, configure your system using SAP Central Business Configuration as configuration environment. Projects using the Configure Your Solution configuration environment are not supported.
processes.name: Outbound Logistics for Distribution Centers

processes.description:
Output Management (1LQ)

Overview

This scope item provides best practice information for output management in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition that can be used to implement business scenarios that include output-related tasks. This focuses on the reuse of the output control service from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition that is available for different business applications (such as billing document or purchase order). The reuse service offers different capabilities for output of business documents to business receivers. The features that are available in the context of the application are specific to that business application.

Within output management in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, Adobe Forms (XFA) are the standard technology for rendering application objects (such as purchase orders, contracts, or invoices) into PDF. Output management provides the necessary framework for form template development and maintenance, data assembly, rendering, and output determination for forms.

Key Process Flow

  • Document output management requirements

  • Document required communication channels (Print, Email, EDI)

  • Document required document templates (email, forms)

  • Output management setup (printers, email)

  • Customize form templates (add custom fields)

  • Customize master form template (apply corporate branding)

  • Customize email templates

  • Define business rules for output determination

  • Output with attachments

Business Benefits

  • Get ready-to-use output scenarios (predelivered configuration)

  • Integrate into SAP Fiori apps natively

  • Configure sender and recipients for email output flexibly

  • Use templates for email subject and email body (including variables for dynamic content) for email output

  • Print and send attachments via email

  • Define business rules to allow sending multiple messages to multiple recipients using multiple channels at the same time

  • Extend the rules with SAP standard fields and customer fields

  • Perform batch Output with generic sorting for initial output and reprocessing (retry after error and creating duplicates)

  • Reduce total cost of ownership (TCO) by enabling key users (nontechnical users) to add more business fields to configuration settings and Adobe forms
processes.name: Output Management

processes.description:
Overhead Cost Accounting (J54)

Overview

This scope item covers transaction-based actual postings that are used in overhead cost controlling. The purpose of overhead cost controlling is the planning, allocation, control, and monitoring of overhead costs.

Cost center accounting takes the costs incurred in a company and allocates them to the actual subareas that caused them. During period-end closing, these costs are distributed to cost centers through automatic allocation. By allocating the cost elements to cost centers in overhead cost controlling, you can control your costs and compare plan and actual costs. The plan/actual comparison at the end of the period helps you to plan, control, and monitor cost behavior. Overhead cost controlling is also a prerequisite for further allocating overhead costs to cost objects (CO-PC), which enables you to conduct a period-specific profitability analysis.

Key Process Flow

  • Record primary costs to cost centers by posting journal entries with reference to a cost center

  • Update cost center with the correct values

  • Post statistical key figures (for use in reporting or as tracing factors for period-based allocations)

  • Distribute primary and secondary costs using an assessment cost element

  • Run the cost centers actual data reporting

  • Reassign costs and revenues

  • Analyze allocation flow

  • Maintain and monitor your cost center budget (optional)

  • Transfer cost center budget

Business Benefits

  • Get a transparent view for an account of a cost center

  • Process a journal entry for various purposes

  • Determine availability of steps required for preparing periodic and year-end activities

  • Determine necessary steps for preparation of periodic and year-end activities

  • Track commitments posted on cost centers

  • Experience no undesired budget overruns and full transparency of the consumed and available budget at any time
processes.name: Overhead Cost Accounting

processes.description:
Payables Financing with Taulia (7MG)

Overview

Taulia's Payables Financing offers three powerful tools to optimize your working capital and cash flow:

  • Dynamic Discounting: Offer early payments to suppliers in exchange for discounts on individual invoices

  • Supply Chain Financing: Provide early payments to suppliers using third-party funds, preserving your cash reserves

  • Virtual Cards: Simplify supplier payments, reduce fraud risk, and extend your working capital

You can flexibly combine Dynamic Discounting and Supply Chain Financing to control when you use your own cash for discounts versus third-party funds to manage cash flow. This versatile approach allows you to tailor your payment strategy to your current financial needs and goals.

Key Process Flow

  • Replicate supplier master and payables transaction data to Taulia platform automatically

  • Use Taulia to analyze your supplier spend

  • Assign suppliers to Dynamic Discounting, Supply Chain Financing, or Virtual Cards on Taulia

  • Let supplier request early payments per invoice

  • Update invoices automatically based on the program

  • Use standard payment run to clear and pay invoices as needed

Business Benefits

  • Improve your liquidity and cash flow by using Dynamic Discounting, Supply Chain Financing, or Taulia Virtual Cards

  • Diversify funding sources through a multi-funder approach for Supply Chain Financing

  • Strengthen your entire supply chain network by providing supplier the ability to get paid early

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is a customer-managed integration and is defaulted to be a non-standard scope item. Additionally, this scope item requires a license for SAP Taulia Solutions for SAP Finance.
processes.name: Payables Financing with Taulia

processes.description:
Payroll Processing with SAP ERP HCM Payroll (3UP)

Overview

For customers considering integration between SAP ERP HCM Payroll and SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, this scope item gives you the security of direct connectivity to post your payroll results to your financial system in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition using web services, such as for cost center validation, accounting assignment checks, or journal entry display. In addition, it ensures the availability of all cost center data in the payroll system.

Based on the additional country/region-specific posting functionalities, ensure that the corresponding country/region is supported and has no limitations via SAP Note 2767439.

Key Process Flow

  • Transfer cost center data from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to SAP ERP HCM Payroll

  • Read configuration out of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

  • Create posting documents

  • Check documents

  • Release documents

  • Transfer posting documents

Business Benefits

  • Ensure master data consistency (such as cost center replication) between SAP ERP HCM Payroll and SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

  • Transfer payroll postings
processes.name: Payroll Processing with SAP ERP HCM Payroll

processes.description:
Payroll Processing with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll (1NL)

Overview

For customers who want to integrate SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll and SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, this scope item gives you the security of direct connectivity to post your payroll results to your financial system in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition using Web Services. As an example, this can be used to validate cost centers, check accounting assignments, or display journal entries. In addition, it ensures the availability of all cost center data in the payroll system.

Based on the additional country/region-specific posting functionality, ensure that the corresponding country/region is supported and has no limitations via SAP Notes 2707220 and 3537575.

Key Process Flow

  • Transfer cost center data from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll

  • Read configuration out of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

  • Create posting documents

  • Check documents

  • Release documents

  • Transfer posting documents

Business Benefits

  • Ensure master data consistency (such as cost center replication) between SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll and SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

  • Transfer payroll postings

  • Integrate SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll fully with the entire SAP SuccessFactors HR Suite and with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition
processes.name: Payroll Processing with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll

processes.description:
Period-End Closing – Maintenance Orders (BF7)

Overview

This scope item supports activities required for Reactive Maintenance (4HH) and Proactive Maintenance (4HI) scope items. Once the cost is recorded in order types YA01 (Reactive Maintenance), YA02 (Proactive Maintenance), YA03 (Improvement Maintenance), YA04 (Operational Maintenance), and YA05 (Overhead Maintenance), this scope item is executed as a follow-up for settlement, closing, and reporting.

Key Process Flow

  • Settle service orders

  • Close completed service orders

  • Perform orders actual data reporting

Business Benefits

  • Processes period-end closing quickly

  • Reports efficiently
processes.name: Period-End Closing – Maintenance Orders

processes.description:
Period-End Closing – Projects (BNA)

Overview

This scope item consolidates several cost allocation and reporting functions:

  • Overhead calculation: This process allocates indirect expenses associated with project execution using costing sheets to define the rules for overhead calculation.

  • Cost settlement: This involves transferring costs from the project to respective cost objects like cost centers or Assets under Construction (AuC). Settlement rules specify how costs are distributed from WBS elements.

  • Cost settlement for investment projects/AuC: This applies when a company creates its own assets. During the construction phase, all actual postings are assigned to an AuC. Once the asset is completed, the next project settlement run transfers the AuC asset value to the finished asset. You can settle costs to an AuC either periodically or through event-based settlement. With the event-based approach, costs are automatically settled from the investment project to the AuC with each posting made to the investment project.

Overhead accountants must ensure all project-related costs are accurately recorded in the system. Several reports support this task.

Key Process Flow

  • Run overhead calculation – Actual to calculate and post actual overhead

  • Maintain settlement rules manually

  • Automatically generate settlement rules (only available for overhead or investment projects)

  • Run settlement – Actual to calculate amounts to be settled and post settlement documents

  • Additional process steps for investment projects:

    • Define settlement rules for preliminary settlement to CO receivers before the periodic settlement to AuC

    • Run settlement – Actual to settle to AuC

    • Create fixed assets as receivers for the final settlement

    • Maintain settlement rule for final settlement to the fixed asset

    • Perform final settle to fixed asset

  • Monitor projects via project cost reports

Business Benefits

  • Allocate overhead costs to final receivers using rule-based automation

  • Eliminate the need for settlement to profitability segments by automatically deriving profitability attributes

  • Minimize inconsistencies in complex projects by reducing manual maintenance of settlement rules

  • Generate settlement rules automatically to reduce maintenance effort
processes.name: Period-End Closing – Projects

processes.description:
Permit to Work (7Z4)

Overview

The Permit to Work (PTW) process is a formal system used in various asset-centric industries to ensure that high-risk jobs (such as hot work, confined space entry, electrical isolation, work at height, and so on) are performed safely and in compliance with regulations. It acts as an authorization tool that ensures work is conducted under controlled conditions and facilitates collaboration between maintenance, operations and safety departments.

Key Process Flow

  • Trigger maintenance order that requires a permit

  • Identify type of permit (for example, hot work, confined space)

  • Create permit in the system

  • Record work scope, hazards, and control measures

  • Review permit and validate precautionary measures by an authorized person

  • Issue permit to the technician before starting the job

  • Perform work under the safety conditions outlined in the permit

  • Inspect site after job completion and close permit in the system

Business Benefits

  • Ensure all high-risk work complies with legal and company safety standards

  • Prevent accidents by enforcing hazard identification and control measures

  • Document approvals, work performed, and conditions for accountability and traceability

  • Provide records for audits, investigations, and regulatory checks through a digital PTW system

  • Standardize processes to reduce delays, miscommunication, and unsafe shortcuts.
processes.name: Permit to Work

processes.description:
Physical Inventory – Cycle Counting (4LU)

Overview

The cycle counting method is a special physical inventory procedure where inventory is counted at regular intervals within a fiscal year. In general, it starts with classification of materials based on ABC analysis or at the user's discretion. Additional counting intervals are set based on classification of materials. The counting intervals depend on the cycle count indicator. Creation of physical inventory documents then takes place. The creation can either be done manually by a requester or automatically (applicable for large volumes) based on cycle count indicator. The physical stocks are compared and realized for the given materials in the system. Any discrepancies in the system quantities and physical count are reviewed. The inventory may be recounted until final counts are accepted and inventory differences are posted.

Key Process Flow

  • Set cycle counting classification

  • Schedule physical inventory document creation

  • Print physical inventory documents

  • Execute physical count or recount

  • Enter physical count

  • List and post physical count differences

Business Benefits

  • Increase overall inventory accuracy

  • Process inventory adjustments efficiently

  • Enable real-time reporting of your company's warehouse stock
processes.name: Physical Inventory – Cycle Counting

processes.description:
Physical Inventory – Inventory Count and Adjustment (BML)

Overview

The process begins with the generation of the required inventory count sheets. Materials can be blocked here for posting during the physical inventory. Once the inventory sheets are printed out, the actual physical inventory count is realized for the given materials. The count result is entered in the system and discrepancies in the system quantities are reviewed. The inventory may be recounted until final counts are accepted and inventory differences are posted.

Key Process Flow

  • Create physical inventory documents

  • Print physical inventory documents

  • Execute physical count or recount

  • Enter physical count

  • List and post physical count differences

Business Benefits

  • Get a transparent view on the stocks currently available

  • Process inventory adjustments efficiently
processes.name: Physical Inventory – Inventory Count and Adjustment

processes.description:
Physical Inventory for Distribution Centers (5FS)

Overview

Real-time accurate stock information is essential for many key processes involving distribution centers, for example requirements planning or replenishment, allocation processes, and accounting. Especially for the sales process, it's mandatory to base availability information for the customer on up-to-date stock information (determined via Available-To-Promise calculation, which also considers, among others, planned goods receipts and issues). Furthermore, regular physical inventory counting is mandatory to meet legal requirements. Typically, inventory of all articles must be counted at least once a year.

Physical inventory counts can be triggered via various methods, such as cycle counting used to carry out physical inventory for sets of articles at regular intervals during a year.

First, physical inventory documents are created. The actual physical inventory is then executed by measuring, counting, and weighing stock, and entering the results in the physical inventory documents.

If the results differ from the expected quantities, a recount can be triggered or an immediate stock adjustment can be posted. The stock adjustment is documented by an article document and a corresponding update in financial accounting.

Key Process Flow

  • Create physical inventory documents

  • Print physical inventory documents (optional)

  • Enter inventory count

  • Request physical inventory recount (optional)

  • Post inventory count differences

  • Display physical inventory analysis

Business Benefits

  • Improve supply chain FTE productivity by increasing automation and improving access to real-time information

  • Increase inventory accuracy by immediately updating differences in stock and inventory values

This scope item is part of a bundle that requires a license for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, retail, fashion, and vertical business and the activation of business functions. This bundle includes several scope items that need to be activated together when you activate the bundle. To request the activation of the retail bundle from SAP cloud operations, create a ticket for component XX-S4C-OPR-SRV.

As a prerequisite, configure your system using SAP Central Business Configuration as configuration environment. Projects using the Configure Your Solution configuration environment are not supported.

processes.description:
Planning and Production in Other Plant – Consumer Products (7DN)

Overview

This scope item describes a cross-plant production planning and execution process tailored for the Consumer Products Industry. The process involves two plants: Plant 1 serves as the planning and packaging plant using production orders, while Plant 2 produces semifinished materials using process manufacturing.

The process begins with creating a demand forecast for the finished goods, represented by Planned Independent Requirements (PIRs) in Plant 1. Based on these PIRs, Material Requirements Planning (MRP) generates a production plan for finished goods and explodes the entire bill of material structure across both plants. As a result, the demand for semifinished component production, packaging, and raw materials is planned in both plants, depending on the BOM structure.

The production process starts by converting a planned order to a process order or directly creating a process order in Plant 2. Subsequently, goods issue of components, confirmation of production, and goods receipt of the semifinished goods are executed. Plant 1 hosts all major packaging materials, including those relevant for Plant 2. The withdrawal via pick list is executed cross-plant: Cartons are posted directly in Plant 1, even though Plant 2 consumes the material, while Plant 2 picks and posts other components. Moreover, the goods receipt of the semifinished material is posted directly in Plant 1, even though production takes place in Plant 2, eliminating the need for a separate stock transfer process.

Plant 1 stores the semifinished material until a customer places an order for the finished material, triggering the packaging process. The MRP run creates convertible planned orders according to customer requirements. The packaging process begins with converting these planned orders to production orders. After production and goods receipt of the finished material in the unrestricted stock, the system can deliver the sales order and initiate the billing process.

Key Process Flow

  • Conduct Anonymous Forecast and MRP

  • Prduce Semifinished Material

  • Create Sales Order

  • Perform Packaging Process

  • Perform Delivery Processing

  • Handle Billing Process

Business Benefits

  • Get a transparent view of outstanding stock transfers and stock in transit

  • Process internal stock transfers efficiently

  • Detect shortages quickly

  • Create purchase requisitions or scheduling lines to cover demand automatically

  • Get higher accuracy of purchased quantities

  • Save costs through process automation

  • Detect and resolve MRP material exceptions

  • Make use of time-dependent safety stock or time-dependent days of supply definition for replenishment

  • Make-to-stock production based on run schedules without reference to sales orders

  • Simplified handling of the production process with full cost control

  • Confirmation of assembly activities without using production or process orders
processes.name: Planning and Production in Other Plant – Consumer Products
