processes.description:
Stock Transfer with Delivery (BME)

Overview

The stock transfer process begins with a requirement to transfer material from one plant to another within the same company code. This request, in the form of a stock transfer requisition, may be created in the procuring plant automatically by MRP or manually by a buyer.

The material master must exist in both the procuring (receiving) plant and the providing (shipping) plant. Stock transfer purchase orders are not subject to approval like other purchase orders.

A buyer converts the stock transfer purchase requisition to a stock transfer purchase order. A warehouse clerk at the shipping plant monitors the materials due to be shipped and creates deliveries as required.

A warehouse clerk gathers the materials and confirms the picked quantities. Once the delivery is complete, the delivery quantities are issued, and the goods are shipped, ending the process for the shipping plant.

Goods are received at the receiving plant referencing to the stock transfer order.

Key Process Flow

  • Create stock transport requisition (with MRP)

  • Change stock transport purchase order (with MRP)

  • Create stock transport order (without MRP)

  • Create replenishment delivery for stock transport order

  • Pick and post goods issue for stock transport order

  • Perform inbound delivery

  • Receive transferred material

Business Benefits

  • Get a transparent view of outstanding stock transfers and stock in transit

  • Process internal stock transfers efficiently

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item requires additional manual setup. If you requested this scope item, see the set-up instructions in SAP Signavio Process Navigator.
processes.name: Stock Transfer with Delivery

processes.description:
Stock Transfer Without Delivery (BMH)

Overview

The process begins with a requirement to transfer material from one plant to another within the same company code. The stock transfer without delivery can be performed in two different ways.

A one-step transfer posting at the issuing plant moves the stock immediately from the issuing plant to the receiving plant. This is useful if the distance between the two plants is short and there is no need for stock-in-transit stock overview.

A buyer at the receiving plant requests material with a stock transport order. This is useful if the issuing plant needs a formal request to send material to the receiving plant or the distance between the two plants is longer.

There are no master data requirements beyond the material master to support the stock transfer process. The material master must exist in both the procuring (receiving) plant and the providing (issuing) plant. Also, stock transfer purchase orders are not subject to approval like other purchase orders.

Key Process Flow

  • Transfer stock in one step

  • Create stock transport order

  • Post goods issue for stock transport order

  • Check the status of the stock transfer

  • Receive transferred materials

Business Benefits

  • Handle processes simply where delivery is not required

  • Generate fewer documents

  • Monitor stock in transit

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item requires additional manual setup steps. If you requested this scope item, check the set-up instructions in the SAP Signavio Process Navigator.
processes.name: Stock Transfer Without Delivery

processes.description:
Store Connectivity – Inbound (3HV)

Overview

Business transactions originating from point-of-sale (POS) solutions in the stores are regularly transferred and trigger the posting of relevant documents. Typically, the transactions aren't sent directly from the POS solutions. Most retailers send transactions from the POS first to a solution where all transactions are collected, audited, and aggregated. We recommend using the SAP Omnichannel Sales Transfer and Audit solution for this purpose. From this solution, aggregated transactions (and, in specific use cases, non-aggregated (receipt-level) transactions) are periodically pushed to the back end for further processing.

Relevant transactions include sales, returns, customer order payments, and pure financial transactions. Based on this, documents for goods movements and billing are created, as well as the respective financial postings. The processed sales data are the basis for follow-on processes like replenishment.

This data includes:

  • Aggregated sales data: typically, at granular level, such as store, article, or day

  • Aggregated payment list: transactions are accumulated based on the payment methods

  • Sales per receipt and returns: single sales transaction with relevant details, including means of payment

  • Customer order payment: payment for a referenced customer order

  • Financial transactions: import of purely financial transactions (that is, transactions that only affect financial accounting)

You can send confirmation messages to the source solution to acknowledge successful processing of the received transactions.

Efficient and user-friendly monitoring and exception handling are ensured via integration into Application Interface Framework (AIF). Technically, the communication is implemented via asynchronous SOAP services.

Key Process Flow

  • Transfer sales and financial transactional data from POS

  • Post billing documents, goods movements, and financial documents automatically

  • Monitor and reprocess messages for exceptions

Business Benefits

  • Improve data quality by monitoring and validating correctness and consistency of data coming from store management and POS systems

  • Increase data accuracy in the back end by transmitting correct information on sales and financial data from POS and store management systems

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is part of a bundle that requires a license for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, retail, fashion, and vertical business and the activation of business functions. This bundle includes several scope items that need to be activated together when you activate the bundle. To request the activation of the retail bundle from SAP cloud operations, create a ticket for component XX-S4C-OPR-SRV.

As a prerequisite, configure your system using SAP Central Business Configuration as configuration environment. Projects using the Configure Your Solution configuration environment are not supported.
processes.name: Store Connectivity – Inbound

processes.description:
Store Connectivity – Outbound (3I2)

Overview

Point-of-sale (POS) systems in the stores must be provided with the data necessary to enable selling articles to consumers, such as sales prices and article master data (including article description, tax information, and Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) for scanning). You can configure messages such that only needed information is gathered (for example, supplier and purchase price). Obviously, it's of major importance that information in the POS solutions is always up to date. This can be ensured via the following process variants:

  • Supply the POS with all needed master data via an initial load, for example when a new store is opened

  • Automatically update the POS with the changed article data in regular intervals

  • In exceptional cases, you can manually start an immediate supply of the POS, such as for short-term sales price changes

Technically, the communication is implemented as an asynchronous SOAP service.

Key Process Flow

  • Define filter settings to restrict the set of articles to meet certain criteria

  • Transfer all relevant articles to POS via an initial load

  • Transfer changed data via delta load to the POS solutions

  • Start an immediate transfer of selected articles manually for the POS in exceptional cases

  • Monitor distribution status of the replication scenario and analyze errors (optional)

Business Benefits

  • Reduce customer billing and credit collections costs by providing consistent and correct article and price information into all POS systems

  • Reduce data integration costs by using tailored service offerings to provide stores and POS systems with consistent data

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is part of a bundle that requires a license for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, retail, fashion, and vertical business and the activation of business functions. This bundle includes several scope items that need to be activated together when you activate the bundle. To request the activation of the retail bundle from SAP cloud operations, create a ticket for component XX-S4C-OPR-SRV.

As a prerequisite, configure your system using SAP Central Business Configuration as configuration environment. Projects using the Configure Your Solution configuration environment are not supported.

processes.description:
Store Ordering from Distribution Center (5FX)

Overview

Stores procure their merchandise either directly from external suppliers or from distribution centers. When stores procure their merchandise from distribution centers, the procurement document is created in the form of a stock transfer order or stock transport order. The procurement process is supported in scenarios where the store and the distribution center operate in the same or a different company code (advanced intercompany process). Both process variants are supported. Typically, the demand of the store is determined automatically by the replenishment planning application, resulting in a creation of stock transfer requisitions. The conversion from a stock transfer requisition to a stock transport order can be done manually or automatically (applicable for large volumes). Alternatively, you can create transport orders manually.

Key Process Flow

  • Create stock transport order manually

  • Create stock transport order with reference to a stock transport requisition

  • Convert stock transfer requisitions to stock transport orders automatically

Business Benefits

  • Streamline procurement processes in an efficient and cost-effective manner

  • Ensure highly automated processes for the store ordering from distribution center

  • Reduce manual effort greatly

  • Improve productivity of procurement in the store by supporting automatic creation of stock transfer orders from distribution centers and stores

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is part of a bundle that requires a license for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, retail, fashion, and vertical business and the activation of business functions. This bundle includes several scope items that need to be activated together when you activate the bundle. To request the activation of the retail bundle from SAP cloud operations, create a ticket for component XX-S4C-OPR-SRV.

As a prerequisite, configure your system using SAP Central Business Configuration as configuration environment. Projects using the Configure Your Solution configuration environment are not supported.

processes.description:
Subcontracting – Consumer Products (5W4)

Overview

This business process describes a subcontracting process in the Consumer Products industry, using Subcontracting MRP Areas for disposition and Quality Inspection during goods receipt from subcontractor. It outlines a typical display packaging process executed by a subcontractor with the provision of components. Workflow functionalities are optional.

The process begins with creating demand forecast for finished subcontracting materials, represented by Planned Independent Requirements (PIRs). You can enter these PIRs manually or upload them via a load file. Based on PIRs, Material Requirements Planning creates a purchasing plan for the finished materials and explodes the Bill of Materials structure for the component, which will be provided to the subcontractor. As a result, finished and packaging material demands are planned, leading to planned orders or purchase requisitions that trigger alternative procurement or production scenarios (not part of this business process).

The display packaging can either be done in house (via production order – not part of the scenario) or sent to a subcontractor, for example, due to machine breakdown or limited capacity. The MRP run creates planned orders that can be converted to a production order (not part of this scenario) or to a purchase requisition. The purchase requisition is converted into a subcontract purchase order. As an alternative, the purchase order can be created manually by a requestor. The purchase order is subject to approval based on predefined parameters before being issued to the subcontractor.

The system creates the outbound delivery, and the materials are picked and shipped to the subcontractor. The picking process transfers the components to the subcontracting MRP Area, indicating that the company still owns the components, but they are now at the subcontractor site.

The consumption of the sent components from the subcontracting MRP Area is recorded upon the receipt of the value-added finished material. When you supply the finished material, the goods receipt is created. Subsequently, the invoicing process is triggered.

As a process variant, inbound deliveries can be created to be able to monitor the delivery date. In that case, the goods receipt will be executed with relation to the inbound delivery and not to the purchase order.

The components sent to the subcontractor and the subcontracted material are batch-managed. This might cause difficulties with the batch confirmation of the installed components, especially when producing the subcontracted material consumes several components. The subcontractor, who receives the component batches, can't always guarantee which component batch was consumed in which subcontracted material batch. This can be due to organizational, personnel, or cost reasons.

To ensure traceability, the component batches are partially anonymized before they are sent to the subcontractor. This means that several component batches of a product are combined into one anonymous delivery batch by transferring the batch to batch of the component. It is easier for the subcontractor to report back the delivery batch of the components that has been included in a subcontracted material batch.

When the goods receipt is posted for the subcontracted finished good, the components are automatically posted and the component stock at the subcontractor is decreased.

The finished material is posted to quality inspection stock and an inspection lot is created based on an inspection plan. The quality technician records the inspection results. Based on these results, the quality engineer makes a usage decision, such as accepting or rejecting the material, or posting the material to unrestricted or blocked stock. If the results are rejected, a defect is automatically recorded.

If the components and the display are batch-managed, there can be difficulties with the batch confirmation of the installed components, especially when several components are installed in a display. If the display consists of several components and their component batches and the subcontractor has been sent several component batches, they cannot always guarantee that they can record which component batch was installed in which display batch. This can be due to organizational, personnel, or cost reasons.

To ensure traceability, the component batches are partially anonymized before they are sent to the subcontractor. This means that several component batches of a product are combined into one delivery batch. It is easier for the subcontractor to report back the delivery batch of the components that have been included in a display batch.

The component batch is made anonymous as a delivery batch by transferring the batch to batch of the component.

Key Process Flow

  • Create purchasing info record

  • Check flexible workflow of purchase order

  • Configure flexible workflow of purchase order

  • Change master inspection characteristic for visual pack check

  • Create inspection plan for subcontracted material

  • Create initial material stock

  • Create batch

Business Benefits

  • Create demand forecast for finished subcontracting products

  • Enable creation of a purchasing plan based in Planned Independent Requirements (PIRs)

  • Involve subcontractors and serve the required bill of material (BOM) structure for the required components

  • Involve subcontractors for production normally done in house (for example, due to machine break or limited capacity)
processes.name: Subcontracting – Consumer Products

processes.description:
Subcontracting (BMY)

Overview

A subcontract purchase requisition is either generated via the Material Requirements Planning (MRP) process or manually by a requestor. The purchase requisition is converted into a subcontract purchase order. The purchase order is subject to approval based on predefined parameters before being issued to the subcontractor. The outbound delivery is created, and the goods are picked and shipped to the subcontractor. With the supply of the finished material, the goods receipt is created. The consumption of the sent components is recorded upon the receipt of the value-added finished material. Subsequently, the invoicing process is triggered.

Key Process Flow

  • Manage purchase orders

  • Manage stock

  • Manage outbound deliveries

  • Pick and post goods issues

  • Manage goods receipts

  • Manage invoices

  • Serial number processing

  • Manage inbound deliveries

  • Post goods receipt for inbound delivery

Business Benefits

  • Streamline subcontracting processes efficiently and cost-effectively

  • Ensure highly automated processes

  • Reduce manual effort greatly

  • Monitor the process progress in real-time
processes.name: Subcontracting

processes.description:
Subscription Management for Software (5SW)

Overview

This scope item enables an integrated end-to-end process across SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, SAP Subscription Billing, and SAP Entitlement Management.

The process covers software subscription modeling and pricing, selling, fulfillment, provisioning, license and software usage, billing, and revenue recognition. It describes the end-to-end process for a new subscription contract, as well as various change processes for subscriptions and the respective fulfillment and provisioning, including license and tenant decommissioning at the end of a subscription contract.

The scope item combines the existing scope items Subscription Management with Sales Billing (57Z), the subscription product part of scope item Solution Order Management (4GT), and scope item Event-Based Revenue Recognition – Subscription Billing (5DQ), extended with processes in SAP Entitlement Management.

The test script is intended for you to manually test the scope item. In a productive implementation, most processes run automatically, monitoring for exceptions. In such an implementation, you can manually create or extend the SAP S/4HANA Cloud solution order and changes in the SAP subscription billing subscription. The SAP Entitlement Management processes run fully automated, assuming license usage and software usage and adoption postings are also automated.

Key Process Flow

  • Create solution orders in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition with subscription products

  • Replicate subscription items from solution orders from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to SAP Subscription Billing

  • Replicate SAP Subscription Billing contracts to SAP Entitlement Management to generate entitlements and licenses (for applications and capabilities with different license metrics)

  • Group subscription contracts and entitlements under a master agreement for unified provisioning (base licenses and add-on licenses are provisioned in one infrastructure of application tenants used by a specific customer division, separate from other customer divisions)

  • Re-use provisioned tenants for add-ons or contract replacements, moving from one to a different base subscription product edition

  • Trigger provisioning requests for downstream provisioning via iFlow from SAP Entitlement Management

  • Simulate provisioning responses to SAP Entitlement Management using SAP Business Acceleration Hub

  • Activate subscription contracts in SAP Subscription Billing from SAP Entitlement Management upon completed provisioning

  • Record tenant capabilities, license consumption, and software usage in SAP Entitlement Management

  • Collect usage data and automated rating of usage, recurring, and one-time charges in SAP Subscription Billing

  • Transfer billing data from SAP Subscription Billing to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to generate billing document requests

  • Process billing requests into customer billing documents

  • Recognize revenue for provider contracts and support revenue splits across multi-application license editions

  • Manage subscription and entitlement changes (for example, quantity, duration, upgrades, replacements)

  • Decommission licenses and tenants after contract and entitlement expiration

Business Benefits

  • Model, sell, fulfill, and bill software subscriptions through an integrated, automated end-to-end process

  • Use a generic license template supporting multiple applications, tenant types, license metrics, and capabilities

  • Automate provisioning, updates, and decommissioning of tenants, license metrics, and application capabilities

  • Re-use application tenants for add-on, replacement, or successor license contracts with different license edition or successor licenses

  • Measure license consumption to identify low adoption (churn risk) or over-usage (revenue leakage)

  • Track software usage and adoption for deeper insights into customer and product success

  • Support flexible subscription models including one-time, recurring, and usage-based billing

  • Enable integrated revenue recognition

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item requires additional licenses for SAP Subscription Billing and SAP Entitlement Management.
processes.name: Subscription Management for Software

processes.description:
Subscription Management with Convergent Invoicing (5IK)

Overview

SAP Subscription Billing offers a simplified, automated approach to manage and bill your subscriptions. SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition provides advanced financial processes for invoicing, accounting, and controlling. The scenario combines the capabilities of both solutions to create an integrated subscription management process.

Subscriptions are created via API in SAP Subscription Billing. SAP Subscription Billing manages the subscription lifecycle, charges recurring rates, prices usage data, and prepares the billing data at the end of each billing cycle. The system forwards the billing data to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition Convergent Invoicing where tax amounts are added and the invoice is created. The invoiced amounts are then available in receivable management, contract accounting, contract-based revenue recognition (CBRR), and controlling.

Key Process Flow

  • Replicate customer master data between SAP Subscription Billing and SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

  • Create a subscription in SAP Subscription Billing and establish a corresponding provider contract in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

  • Replicate billing data from SAP Subscription Billing to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition convergent invoicing

Business Benefits

  • Foster the transition to a subscription-based business model

  • Improve the operational efficiency and effectiveness in the management and processing of subscriptions

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

The scenario requires the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, contract accounting and invoicing solution to be active.

In addition, you must have a license for the separate product SAP Subscription Billing.
processes.name: Subscription Management with Convergent Invoicing

processes.description:
Subscription Management with Sales Billing (57Z)

Overview

SAP Subscription Billing provides a simplified, automated approach to manage and bill your subscriptions. SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition offers innovative financial processes for invoicing, accounting, and controlling. The scenario unites the capabilities of both solutions to establish an integrated subscription management process.

Subscriptions are created via a user-interface or as part of an SAP S/HANA Cloud solution order in SAP Subscription Billing. SAP Subscription Billing manages the subscription life cycle, charges recurring rates, prices usage data, and prepares the billing data at the end of each billing cycle. The billing data is forwarded to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition sales billing where tax amounts are added and the invoice is created.

The invoiced amounts are then available in receivable management, accounts receivable, event-based revenue recognition and controlling.

Key Process Flow

  • Replicate customer master data between SAP Subscription Billing and SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

  • Create a subscription in SAP Subscription Billing and establish a corresponding provider contract in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

  • Replicate billing data from the SAP Subscription Billing to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition sales billing

Business Benefits

  • Foster the transition to a subscription-based or solution-based business model

  • Improve the operational efficiency and effectiveness in the management and processing of subscriptions

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item requires additional manual set-up steps for its transition to an SAP-managed setup. If you request this scope item, see the set-up instructions in the SAP Activate Roadmap.
processes.name: Subscription Management with Sales Billing

processes.description:
Overview

This scope item facilitates the establishment of an integration between SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition and Central Finance. The integration enables the replication of financial transaction data from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to Central Finance. Activation of this data replication is feasible at the company code level within the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition system.

Integration is achieved using Cloud Integration technologies (SAP Business Connector, Cloud Connector, WebSocket RFC). and the SAP Landscape Transformation Replication Server.

Key Process Flow

  • Maintain relevant company codes for replication to Central Finance
  • Activate Communication Scenario SAP_COM_0083 to replicate transactional data via SAP LT Replication Server

Business Benefits

  • Integrate subsidiary finance data with your corporate Central Finance system automatically
  • Consolidate financial and management reporting in Central Finance, including subsidiaries running SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition
  • Get detailed visibility of financial information down to the transaction level

Exclude from Default Activation

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

Reason for Excluding from Default Activation

Substance Volume Tracking (4OL)

Overview

With this scope item, you can enable tracking of confirmed substance volumes from purchasing, manufacturing, and sales. Substance volume tracking helps you comply with chemical regulations. These regulations require you to track and monitor the volumes of regulated substances that you import to, produce in, or export to a country or region within a certain period. Substance volume tracking is integrated with the logistics processes for purchasing, manufacturing, and sales and tracks, calculates, aggregates, and monitors the imported, produced, and exported substance volumes that result from the processes, considering the system configuration.

Key Process Flow

  • Post goods receipt for a purchase order

  • Create a sales order

  • Add a market assessment (optional)

  • Create a delivery

  • Post goods issue for an outbound delivery

  • Perform substance volume tracking in background

  • Monitor substance volumes

  • Check substance volume tracking status

  • Trace aggregated substance volumes back to the logistics document from which the substance volumes originate

Business Benefits

  • Enable tracking, calculation, and aggregation of volumes of imported, produced, and exported substances on a legal entity level and based on the relevant compliance requirements and tracking period

  • Simplify the comparison between the aggregated substance volumes and the thresholds in the relevant compliance requirements by calculating a substance volume tracking status

  • Support monitoring of substance volumes tracing back to the respective logistics document via an SAP Fiori app

For this reason, the supplier is informed of withdrawals of consignment stock on a regular basis.

processes.description:
Supplier Consignment for Retail (71P)

Overview

In the consignment process, the supplier retains the complete (legal) ownership of the merchandise until the retailer sells it to a customer (buyer). From a financial perspective, the inventory is kept in the supplier account, and the retailer has non-valuated stocks in distribution centers and stores. For the retailer, an advantage of the consignment process is the reduced risk due to no capital tie up for the respective products. Additionally, the supplier can address customer's requirements without the need for its own sales force and marketing activities.

During article master maintenance, you can decide if supplier consignment is relevant for each site.​

It's essential that the consignment stock category is preserved in all goods movements. Consignment stock can be transferred from distribution center to stores, and more often, goods in consignment stock can be transferred across sites as necessary. In the point-of-sale (POS) inbound processing, the stock category is determined and the consignment inventory is adjusted. For the customer order-based sales process at store and distribution center, goods issues can be posted from the consignment stock.

All variations of return processes are supported – from store to the external supplier directly, or in two-steps process, which is from store to distribution center and then from distribution center to the supplier. In the stock overview, you can view if the inventory is company-owned by the retailer or consigned by a supplier.

Concerning the settlement, the supplier doesn't issue the invoice directly to the retailer after the merchandise arrives at the premises of the retailer. The retailer is liable to pay the supplier only when the stock is consumed. Thus, a retailer triggers a settlement through different types of movements, for example, from POS sales, from sales orders, or from other stock adjustments.

Key Process Flow

  • Mark article master data per site as relevant for consignment

  • Procure consignment articles from external supplier for site

  • Receive goods at site into supplier consignment stock​

  • Transport stock between store and distribution center​

  • Process sales transactions originating at point-of-sale (POS)

  • Process sales transactions from distribution center

  • Manage in-store customer orders

  • Fulfill omnichannel orders

  • Return consignment stock from store to distribution center

  • Return supplier consignment stock from site to supplier

  • Settle consumed consignment stock with supplier

  • View stock overview of supplier consignment

  • Process customer order-based sales in store ​

  • Process customer order based sales in distribution center

  • Process omnichannel customer order-based sales

Business Benefits

  • Reduce inventory carrying cost by leveraging supplier stock in consignment ​

  • Improve customer satisfaction by offering larger ranges of products using supplier consignment ​

This scope item can only be activated if you have a license for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, retail, fashion, and vertical business and have activated the retail bundle. To request the activation of the retail bundle from SAP cloud operations, create a ticket for component XX-S4C-OPR-SRV.

As a prerequisite, configure your system using SAP Central Business Configuration as configuration environment. Projects using the Configure Your Solution configuration environment are not supported.

processes.description:
Supply Chain Automation with SAP Business Network (5I2)

Overview

This scope item handles several supply chain processes as an integrated end-to-end solution. It includes SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition and SAP Business Network for Supply Chain.

Subcontracting

Subcontract purchase requisitions are generated either through the material requirements planning (MRP) process or manually by requestors. These requisitions are then converted into subcontract purchase orders. Purchase orders require approval based on predefined parameters before they're issued to subcontractors. Once approved, outbound deliveries are created, and goods

(e.g. components and/ or raw materials) are picked and shipped to subcontractors. After the delivery of the finished materials, goods receipts are created. The consumption of sent the previously provided components is recorded when the value-added finished materials are received. This process subsequently initiates invoicing. The integrated Subcontracting processes focuses on externally produced materials (make-to-stock).

Scheduling Agreements

Scheduling agreements are long-term contracts with suppliers for the supply of materials under predetermined conditions. These conditions are valid for a specific period and a defined total purchase quantity. You can use scheduling agreements either with release documentation.

Customizing controls this through an indicator when you define the document type for scheduling agreements. For agreements with release documentation, use the LPA document type.

SA schedule lines are created with reference to a purchase scheduling agreement either through the material requirements planning process (MRP) or manually by requesters. Once the SA release has been carried out, an SA delivery schedule (forecast/JIT) is issued and communicated to the supplier. Based on the SA delivery schedule, the supplier delivers the requested goods and notifies about the upcoming delivery by sending an ASN. After the ASN has been converted into an inbound delivery, the goods receipt is posted, and the logistics invoice verification is carried out.

Multi-Tier Collaboration

Multi-Tier Collaboration lets you work with multiple trading partners across various processes, systems, and geographies in real time. It enhances transparency by sharing purchase orders, order confirmations, and advance ship notifications with multiple suppliers. This feature allows supply chain partners to access copies of orders, confirmations, and ship notices, with financial fields masked. They can also create component receipts upon receiving shipments. OEM buyers can manage their copy documents and view component shipments and receipts from tiered suppliers.

Advanced Packaging with Handling Units

Customers need standardized packaging for the materials and products they order and receive from suppliers. Without support for Handling Units during the creation of advanced shipping notifications, materials may be packed arbitrarily. This makes it challenging for customers to streamline their receiving and put-away processes. In this scenario, the replication of packaging instructions as well as the creation of ASNs with packaging data (specified in the replicated PI) is described.

Key Process Flow

  • Subcontracting

    • Send approved purchase orders electronically to your suppliers through SAP Business Network.

    • Receive digital order confirmations automatically from your suppliers.

    • Process digital advanced shipping notifications from suppliers in SAP Business Network into inbound deliveries in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.

    • Send goods receipts to suppliers in SAP Business Network automatically.

    • Receive invoices from suppliers electronically in SAP Business Network.

    • Update suppliers digitally in SAP Business Network on invoice status.

    • Start payment runs upon receiving supplier invoices in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.

    • Send payment advices to suppliers through SAP Business Network automatically.

  • Scheduling Agreements

    • Send release to supplier via SAP Business Network for scheduling agreements with releases

    • Process digital advanced shipping notifications from your suppliers electronically in SAP Business Network

    • Convert shipping notifications into inbound deliveries in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

    • Automatically send goods receipts to suppliers through SAP Business Network

    • Receive invoices from suppliers electronically via SAP Business Network

    • Keep suppliers updated digitally on invoice status changes in SAP Business Network

    • Initiate payment runs upon receiving supplier invoices in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

    • Automatically send payment advices to suppliers through SAP Business Network

  • Multi-Tier Collaboration

    The multi-tier capability can be applied in various process variations. The following sample case illustrates this approach:

    • Buyers create a purchase order and specify one or more partners, who are the multi-tier suppliers.

    • Buyers send the purchase order to the supplier, and copies go to the multi-tier suppliers.

    • Suppliers send an order confirmation to the buyers, and copies go to the multi-tier suppliers.

    • Suppliers send an advanced shipping notification to the buyers, and copies go to the multi-tier suppliers.

    • Suppliers ship the components to the specified party, often one of the multi-tier suppliers.

    • The party receiving the components sends a component receipt to the buyers. This is a manual step not covered by automation today.

    • Buyers send a goods receipt to the suppliers. This is also a manual step not covered by automation today.

    • Suppliers send invoices to the buyers.

  • Advanced Packaging with Handling Units

    The multi-tier capability can be applied in various process variations. The following sample case illustrates this approach:

    • Buyers replicate packaging instructions from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to SAP Business Network.

    • Send purchase orders electronically to your suppliers through SAP Business Network.

    • Suppliers automatically send digital order confirmations.

    • Suppliers also create digital advanced shipping notifications, which are sent electronically through SAP Business Network and converted into inbound deliveries in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition:

      • Suppliers start the advanced packaging process.

      • The system determines matching packaging instructions based on the materials to be packed.

      • Automatic packaging creates a packaging proposal for suppliers, who then edit the packaging structure.

      • SAP Business Network generates handling unit numbers, and suppliers print custom barcode labels.

      • Suppliers complete the creation of advanced shipping notifications.

    • Goods receipts are sent to suppliers in SAP Business Network automatically.

Business Benefits

  • Subcontracting

    • Streamline subcontracting processes efficiently and cost-effectively.

    • Speed up procurement processes and improve compliance.

    • Boost productivity for procurement and accounts payable teams.

    • Reduce payment inquiries from suppliers and enhance productivity in the accounts payable department.

    • Ensure processes are highly automated to minimize manual effort and transactional costs.

    • Monitor process progress in real time.

  • Scheduling Agreements

    • Support supplier planning with predefined pricing and terms over a set horizon

    • Align orders with demand using firm, trade-off, and forecast zones for short-term and long-term needs

  • Multi-Tier Collaboration

    • Enable real-time document sharing (for example, purchase orders, order confirmations, and advanced shipping notifications) across supply chain partners

    • Improve visibility and efficiency for outstanding orders and shipments from component suppliers

  • Advanced Packaging with Handling Units

    • Boost shipping compliance and receiving accuracy through structured packaging processes

    • Use barcode-labeled handling units for precise tracking and reduced manual input

    • Allow flexible packaging execution by buyers or suppliers, guided by clear instructions

Tank Trailer Filling with Residuals (42N)

Overview

The process starts with creation of a filling process order based on an internal or external requirement.

As a prerequisite, the tank trailer with a dedicated container ID should be weighed and the existing residual quantity should be posted to a separate residual storage location. This residual stock is considered during the subsequent filling process for the same container ID.

Using container ID as a reference batch characteristic, the batch and quantity of residual stock for the specific container ID is determined for the process order using batch determination.

The net quantity of manufactured product to be filled into the tank trailer is calculated by deducting the residual material that was already present in the tank from the total filling order quantity. A simple material quantity calculation formula is used for this purpose. The appropriate batches are selected using batch determination.

The filling process order is executed to complete the tank trailer filling process.

Key Process Flow

  • Create process order with batch for tank trailer filling

  • Assign container ID to process order batch

  • Perform batch determination of the materials to be filled at process order level

  • Calculate material quantity of the filling quantity of the material from silo

  • Perform goods issue of the material to be filled and the residue from the residual storage location

  • Confirm the process order

  • Perform goods receipt for the process order

Business Benefits

  • Take accurate account of the quantity of existing residuals in the tank trailer during filling

Test Automation Tool for SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud (86C)

Overview

This scope item enables automated end-to-end testing capabilities through the Test Automation Tool within SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. The tool provides comprehensive test coverage for business processes, ensuring system stability and validating business processes after implementation, updates and upgrades.

The Test Automation Tool is designed to automatically execute and validate business processes with capabilities to define the test scope and maintain test data. The tool enables you to create, maintain, and execute automated test scripts that verify system functionality and process flows with minimal manual intervention. Tests executed through this tool are stored and can be reused for regression testing during system updates and enhancements.

As a prerequisite, you must have test data gathered, including organizational structure and master data such as materials, customers, and vendors. Business user and role authorizations for test execution and result analysis must be assigned appropriately.

This document provides a detailed procedure for configuring and executing automated tests using the Test Automation Tool reflecting the predefined scope of the solution. Each test scenario and validation point is covered in its own section, providing the system interactions (test steps) in a table view. You are required to add project-specific test scenarios.
Note
Test execution results may vary based on system configuration and customizing settings.

Key Process Flow

  • Create a test process

  • Create and execute a test plan

  • Create reusable test data

  • Prepare scope for post-upgrade tests

  • Optimize post-upgrade test scope

  • Trigger post-upgrade tests

  • View results of post-upgrade and custom test plans

Business Benefits

  • Execute more test scenarios in less time

  • Verify new changes quickly without hampering existing functionality

  • Run automated tests more consistently and exhaustively than manual tests

  • Benefit from higher quality business processes and fewer production issues

  • Run automated tests overnight or during off-hours

  • Accelerate release cycles as the tool enables continuous integration/continuous deployment

  • Detect bugs early, reducing expensive post-release fixes

  • Conduct testing with clear, traceable, and consistent documentation, which is valuable for compliance requirements and audit trails

  • Scale and reuse testing reuse across different testing phases and cycles, providing long-term value and adaptability to evolving business needs

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

The scope item is excluded from default activation for the following reasons:

  • Activation of this scope item is not a mandatory prerequisite for any of the solution processes.

  • The purpose of this scope item is to provide documentation for the Test Automation Tool that you can leverage for your regression tests. The tool is enabled only in quality or test tenants and isn't available in production environments.

  • Simplifies the integration of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to Manufacturing Execution Systems for production operation

Overview

You can set the relevant statuses to track the arrival and departure at your locations and set the checkout status to enable freight cost confirmation. You can set statuses for the entire document, as well as for individual stages and locations.

Key Process Flow

  • Monitor the execution of freight documents (such as road freight order, rail freight order, ocean freight booking, air freight booking, and advanced intercompany documents) created in your transportation process

  • Set relevant statuses to track relevant freight documents

  • Set the checkout status to enable the freight cost confirmation for involved freight documents

Business Benefits

  • Support your company's transportation execution in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

  • Increase efficiency through seamless integration between transportation management and warehouse operations

  • Improve supply chain visibility by accurate status reporting

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is only relevant for customers who want to use transportation execution in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.
processes.name: Transportation Execution

processes.description:
Travel Expense Processing with SAP Concur (1M1)

Overview

Cloud-based travel and expense solutions enable users to plan trips and create expense reports. This information is typically transferred to financial systems for posting. Integrate SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition with SAP Concur to export cost objects, import expense reports and cash advances ready for posting, and export posting confirmations. The integration can be performed as a direct connection or through the SAP Cloud Integration service.

Based on the additional country/region-specific posting functionality, ensure that the corresponding country/region is supported and has no limitations. For more information, see the release information and restriction note for local versions updated with every release.

Key Process Flow

  • Set up the system connection, optionally using middleware

  • Export master data, such as cost object master data

  • Integrate financial posting

Business Benefits

  • Process expenses quickly for faster payments

  • Get an end-to-end, timely visibility into spending – from pre-trip plans to final settlement of payments

  • Provide successful financial posting and full process transparency on both sides

  • Save time, optimize resources, and future-proof your investment

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

The scope item requires an additional license for integration of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition with SAP Concur solutions. Ensure that you have a SAP Concur license and that SAP Concur service consultants are assigned to the project to enable all required configurations.
processes.name: Travel Expense Processing with SAP Concur

processes.description:
Treasury Correspondence Integration with SWIFT Network (3QM)

Overview

This scope item uses SAP Multi-Bank Connectivity to integrate treasury correspondence with the SWIFT network.

SWIFT messages for treasury OTC transactions can be delivered to the counterparty's SWIFT code using SAP Multi-Bank Connectivity. SAP Multi-Bank Connectivity acts as a hub and forwards the message to the SWIFT network.

Meanwhile, the SWIFT messages can be sent back from their counterparty via SAP Multi-Bank Connectivity, and relevant incoming correspondence objects are generated automatically in the SAP client. Once the incoming correspondence object is matched with the outgoing correspondence object with confirmation, the OTC transaction is settled accordingly. This function currently covers MT300 for Foreign Exchange instruments and MT320 for Debt and Investment instruments.

Key Process Flow

  • Create outbound correspondence object and outbound SWIFT message

  • Status check of outbound correspondence object

  • Sending outbound SWIFT message to MBC

  • Pull acknowledgment message from MBC

  • Check outbound correspondence object status

  • Pull inbound SWIFT message from MBC

  • Create incoming correspondence object and match it with outgoing object

  • Check matching of correspondence objects

  • Check transaction status

Business Benefits

  • Integrate SWIFT messages in correspondence framework

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is nonstandard and is not activated by default. The customer can request to activate it on demand if they want to use MT300/MT320. This requires additional licenses of for Treasury and Risk Management and SAP Multi-Bank Connectivity (MBC).
processes.name: Treasury Correspondence Integration with SWIFT Network

processes.description:
Treasury Trading via Trading Platforms (2F5)

Overview

This scope item enables you to integrate deal requests and transactions between trading platforms and SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition automatically. We now support financial instruments like Foreign Exchange, Money Market Fixed Term, and Money Market Fund.

Currently, the scope item covers communication with trading platforms for 360T (subsidiary of Deutsche Boerse), FXall (via partner Brisken), and ICD portal.

For the outbound scenario, trade requests generated in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition can be sent to trading platforms through SAP Business Technology Platform. For the inbound scenario, customers can upload transactions automatically from trading platforms to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.

Key Process Flow

  • Analyze exposure and check limit

  • Create deal requests in 360T

  • Quote market rate and choose suitable offer

  • Receive and submit transactions

  • Create transaction contract

  • Enter custom fields

Business Benefits

  • Integrate trading platform automatically

  • Reduce manual operation

  • Store the competitive bids in SAP Could Platform for future reference

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

SAP Business Technology Platform is required for this integration scenario.
processes.name: Treasury Trading via Trading Platforms

processes.description:
Treasury Workstation Accounting Integration (33E)

Overview

This scenario fulfills the requirements for deploying Treasury and Risk Management in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, while keeping the other Finance modules in an existing ERP environment. In such cases, Treasury and Risk Management manages the financial transactions and generates the posting in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition and then transfers the treasury accounting posting to the central accounting system.

Currently, the scenario only supports the SAP ECC system and the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system as the central accounting system.

Key Process Flow

  • Process financial transaction and generate accounting document in sending system

  • Monitor outbound message in sending system

  • Monitor inbound message in receiving system

  • Check accounting document in receiving system

Business Benefits

  • Provide more options for Treasury and Risk Management deployment in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is an integration scenario. It is only required by customers who need a standalone Treasury Management solution. If you requested this scope item, see the set-up instructions in SAP Signavio Process Navigator.
processes.name: Treasury Workstation Accounting Integration

processes.description:
Treasury Workstation Cash Integration (34P)

Overview

Treasury Workstation Cash Integration makes it possible for the treasury workstation in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, normally set up in a group headquarters, to receive the cash flow data from any remote systems of the subsidiaries. This data is incorporated into the various cash reports (for example, Cash Position, Check Cash Flow Items, and Cash Flow Analyzer) for the cash disposition analysis.

With SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition or SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition on either side of the communication, the house bank and account master data can be replicated from one end to the other.

Key Process Flow

  • Send the cash flows into the treasury workstation in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

  • Release the cash flows

  • Check cash flows

  • Replicate the house bank and account data from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

  • Replicate the house bank and account data from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition

  • Monitor replication

Business Benefits

  • Receive more comprehensive and accurate cash disposition analysis on the group level

  • Deploy the group system landscape flexibly

  • Ensure consistent house bank and account master data between the headquarter and the subsidiaries
processes.name: Treasury Workstation Cash Integration

processes.description:
Treasury Workstation Payment Integration (3NA)

Overview

This scenario fulfills the requirements for deploying Treasury and Risk Management in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, while keeping the payment in an existing central Financial Accounting system. In such cases, the Treasury and Risk Management component of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition can trigger the payment request creation or cancellation. Requests are then generated in an SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition or SAP ERP system.

Key Process Flow

  • Process TRM transactions and post flow to generate payment request

  • Monitor IDoc in sending system

  • Monitor IDoc in receiving system

  • Check and process payment request in receiving system

  • Set the transaction-related posting flow for reverse

  • Reverse transaction

  • Monitor IDoc in sending system

  • Monitor IDoc in receiving system

  • Check and process payment request in receiving system

Business Benefits

  • Provide more options for Treasury and Risk Management deployment in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is an integration scenario. It is only required by customers who need a standalone Treasury Management solution. If you requested this scope item, see the set-up instructions in SAP Signavio Process Navigator.
processes.name: Treasury Workstation Payment Integration

processes.description:
Universal Allocation (2QL)

Overview

The Universal Allocation scope item covers plan and actual allocations. For plan allocations of cost centers in overhead cost controlling, it covers the upload of cost center plan data and the execution of the plan allocation cycles. Annual planning is supported via cost redistribution through defined allocation cycles, by definition of sender and receiver rules by fixed amount and percentage. You can control your costs and compare plan and actual costs by allocating the cost elements to cost centers in overhead cost controlling. For examples of actual allocations, see the Overhead Cost Accounting (J54) test script. Profit centers are also covered.

Key Process Flow

  • Import financial plan data

  • Upload statistical key figure plan data

  • Execute cost center actual and plan assessment cycles

  • Execute plan and actual profit center distributions

  • Run plan data reports for cost centers

  • View plan and actual profit center distributions

Business Benefits

  • Gain better control of costs with visibility into how actual costs compare with plan
processes.name: Universal Allocation

processes.description:
Value-Added Services for Retail (6NM)

Overview

Customers often request price labels, custom packaging, or other special services for their orders, which must be completed before delivery. These value-added services (VAS) are essential in retail, especially to meet specific customer expectations. Fulfilling VAS typically requires additional products (materials), expertise, or personnel, and may therefore incur a surcharge.

For example, a customer may order slacks and skirts and request that they be packed separately. Due to the delicate nature of the skirts, the customer specifies that no more than ten be packed per carton. In the system, this packing requirement can be defined as a service type, along with the maximum quantity per carton. A surcharge may be applied to cover the additional handling effort.

This business process covers the configuration and processing of VAS types and subservice types in the order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, and stock transfer processes.

VAS-related costs can be managed using charge codes, which are maintained independently of material pricing and applied as pricing conditions in sales or purchase orders. These codes specify surcharges based on the service’s complexity or resource requirements.

Key Process Flow

  • Maintain VAS types and subservice types

  • Maintain VAS characteristic combinations for determination of VAS in purchase order

  • Maintain VAS for items in sales orders, purchase orders, or stock transport orders

  • Transfer VAS data to follow-on documents such as deliveries and invoices

  • Configure charge codes

  • Use charge codes to apply VAS surcharges

Business Benefits

  • Support customer-specific special services

  • Increase customer satisfaction and operational efficiency

  • Improve supplier collaboration and reduce order processing time

  • Support product readiness during delivery

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item can only be activated if you have a license for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, retail, fashion, and vertical business and have activated the retail bundle. To request the activation of the retail bundle from SAP cloud operations, create a ticket for component XX-S4C-OPR-SRV.

As a prerequisite, configure your system using SAP Central Business Configuration as configuration environment. Projects using the Configure Your Solution configuration environment are not supported.
processes.name: Value-Added Services for Retail

processes.description:
Vendor Performance – Consumer Products (6A6)

Overview

You can evaluate your company's suppliers to obtain a basis for your business relationship with them and to optimize your supply base. Based on the feedback you gather through questionnaires, you obtain a scorecard for each supplier evaluated. The scorecard helps you to assess a supplier’s strengths and shortcomings and to initiate measures for improvement. Evaluation scorecards also let you easily compare suppliers within a peer group.

Ultimately, a combined real-time view across operational and questionnaire-based scores provides a holistic view of your supplier's performance. The business process provides two different use cases for the category manager: Evaluate supplier performance and analyze KPIs based on the evaluation.

Key Process Flow

  • Create the question library

  • Set up analytical reporting currencies (optional)

  • Create purchasing categories

  • Create supplier evaluation weighting and scoring

  • Create sections and questions in question library

  • Create evaluation questionnaire

  • Create group-based evaluation template

  • Start group-based evaluation

  • Maintain evaluation response as appraiser

  • Display scorecards

Business Benefits

  • Assess suppliers' strength and shortcomings

  • Initiate measures for improvements

  • Compare suppliers with a peer group based on evaluation scorecards

  • Earn a holistic view on your supplier's performance

processes.description:
WalkMe Premium Integration (7TE)

Overview

This scope item allows the integration of the WalkMe Premium digital adoption platform product to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to enhance user adoption by user behavior insights, in-application guidance, and step-by-step workflow automation.

Additionally, you can customize standard SAP content and use all features for in app-guidance including AI features, ActionBots (Limited), and workflows.

Key Process Flow

  • Identify critical business workflows that require ongoing training and support

  • Set up the WalkMe Premium solution for use in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

  • Deploy in-application guidance and automation to simplify user experiences

  • Track user behavior for ongoing improvement

  • Maximize user adoption immediately

  • Increase user productivity by providing customizable in app guidance

  • Enable process optimization and automation

  • Accelerate ROI for your enterprise applications

  • Support change management activities

For this scope item, you require an additional license of WalkMe Premium. If you request this scope item, see the set-up instructions in the SAP Signavio Process Navigator.

processes.description:
Warehouse Ad Hoc Goods Issue (3BT)

Overview

This scope item can be used to post unplanned goods issues without reference to outbound deliveries. There are various use cases such as scrapping and goods issue to another storage location. For scrapping, you initiate this process by creating a posting change and a warehouse task to move the material to be scrapped from the source bin to the scrapping zone. After the physical goods movement is completed, you post the unplanned goods issue.

Key Process Flow

  • Create ad-hoc warehouse task (for example, for ad-hoc goods issue to other storage location) and print warehouse tasks lists

  • Create posting change and warehouse task (for example, for scrapping) and print warehouse tasks lists

  • Confirm warehouse tasks

  • Post unplanned goods issue

Business Benefits

  • Support various use cases of an unplanned goods issue

  • Control and record movements of products and handling units in the warehouse

  • Map your warehouse complex in the system down to a storage bin level

  • Improve visibility and control in warehouse processes

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is only relevant for customers that would like to use warehouse management capabilities including storage bin management in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. Caution: Additional organizational entities (for example, storage location, warehouse number, warehouse, storage types) will be activated as part of the warehouse management scope items.
processes.name: Warehouse Ad Hoc Goods Issue

processes.description:
Warehouse Advanced Production Integration (6NI)

Overview

Advanced production integration allows you to have real-time material flow between shop floor and warehouse. You can plan the staging of components to production over a period of time, so that PSA capacity is reasonably used. You can monitor and control the staging process. Consumption can be posted directly from WM and the consumption status can be monitored using an app or RF. Consumption posting can be reversed directly from WM using an app or RF.

You can receive produced stock as soon as the goods receipt request is triggered from the shop floor (both the Post Goods Movement app and the RF are available for the use). You can also clear stock reference on left-over stock from the production supply area, and move them back to the warehouse, after the manufacturing process is complete. In that way, you can free up some capacity from the production supply area for other staging activities, using an app or RF.

Key Process Flow

  • Define the control cycle and the assignment of the storage bin in the production supply area

  • Create manufacturing orders (including production orders and process orders) and trigger creation of production material requests

  • Stage for production with multiple staging methods

  • Monitor consumption for production

  • Reverse consumption for production

  • Perform receipt of finished and semi-finished products

  • Clear product supply areas

Business Benefits

  • Plan staging activities flexibly at a reasonable time and with reasonable quantities, to fully utilize capacity in the production supply area in your warehouse.

  • Use more options to trigger consumption or consumption reversal (for example, via radio frequency (RF) or an app (besides the Post Goods Movement app)

  • Track the staging and consumption processes more transparently regarding PSA stock and manufacturing orders

  • Improve TCO for the reduced number of system documents

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is only relevant for customers that want to use warehouse management capabilities including storage bin management in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.

Caution: Additional organizational entities (for example, storage location, warehouse number, warehouse, and storage types) are activated as part of the warehouse management scope items.
processes.name: Warehouse Advanced Production Integration

processes.description:
Warehouse Goods Receipt from Repetitive Manufacturing (41U)

Overview

This scope item allows you to perform the goods receipt of finished material from repetitive manufacturing into the warehouse. With the repetitive manufacturing confirmation, finished material is received into the specified warehouse goods receipt bin and raw material is issued from stock. The goods receipt (movement type 131) and the goods issue (movement type 261) are posted synchronously in one material document. A new warehouse product attribute/indicator allows you to specify for each product whether to create warehouse tasks from the goods receipt bin to the final storage bin automatically during goods receipt posting or manually after goods receipt posting. In the case of a manual warehouse task creation, you can pack the material into a handling unit as required. You then create warehouse tasks manually to move the material/handling unit from the production goods receipt area to the final storage bin.

Key Process Flow

  • Post goods receipt for finished material and goods issue for raw material

    • Check material document (optional)

    • Check warehouse goods movement document (optional)

  • Variant 1 (Automatic Warehouse Task Creation):

    • Confirm warehouse task

  • Variant 2 (Manual Warehouse Task Creation):

    • Pack finished material (optional)

    • Create handling unit (optional) or product warehouse task

    • Confirm warehouse task

Business Benefits

  • Integrate seamlessly between warehouse management and production (repetitive manufacturing)

  • Keep manual posting effort to a minimum

  • Improve visibility and control in warehouse operations

  • Provide synchronous updates of stock in inventory management and in warehouse management

  • Post goods receipt from repetitive manufacturing into a bin-managed storage location without delivery and warehouse request documents

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is only relevant for customers who use warehouse management capabilities in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition that would like to receive finished material from repetitive manufacturing into the warehouse.
processes.name: Warehouse Goods Receipt from Repetitive Manufacturing

processes.description:
Warehouse Inbound Processing (3BR)

Overview

In this process, products that are delivered with the intent to be stored in the warehouse are received and moved to a storage bin. This scope item allows different variants of inbound processing, such as inbound from supplier, inbound from another storage location, and inbound from another plant.

The process starts with an inbound delivery that is relevant for processing in the warehouse. Once the products arrive at the warehouse, batches and serial numbers can be assigned to the inbound delivery items and handling units can be created. Afterwards, the goods receipt is posted and warehouse tasks are created to execute the movements in the warehouse.

After moving the products to the final bin or the clarification zone (exceptional case), the warehouse tasks are confirmed accordingly.

Key Process Flow

  • Assign or create batch (optional)

  • Change stock type (optional)

  • Capture serial number (optional)

  • Create handling unit and print label (optional)

  • Post goods receipt

  • Create putaway warehouse tasks and print putaway lists

  • Reverse goods receipt (optional)

  • Confirm warehouse tasks

  • Check material in clarification zone (optional)

  • Create warehouse tasks from clarification zone to final bin and print warehouse task lists (optional)

  • Confirm warehouse tasks (optional)

Business Benefits

  • Receive products from different sources and store them in your warehouse

  • Control and record movements of products and handling units in the warehouse

  • Perform packing automatically or manually at work center

  • Map your warehouse complex in the system down to storage bin level

  • Improve visibility and control in warehouse operations

  • Handle exceptions

  • Work with batches and serial numbers

  • Attach files (for example pictures) to inbound deliveries

  • Support most process steps with both app and RF support

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is only relevant for customers who want to use warehouse management capabilities including storage bin management in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. Caution: Additional organizational entities (for example, storage location, warehouse number, warehouse, and storage types) are activated as part of the warehouse management scope items.

Warehouse Inbound Processing with Synchronous Goods Receipt (5HN)

Overview

This scope item describes the synchronous goods receipt for the external procurement process, where the procured products can post the goods receipt directly into the warehouse without involving delivery documents. In this process, products that are delivered with the intent to be stored in the warehouse are received and moved to a storage bin. During the goods receipt process, batches and handling units can be created. The putaway warehouse task creation can be triggered automatically to execute the movements in the warehouse. After moving the products to the final bin or the clarification zone (exceptional case), the warehouse tasks are confirmed accordingly.

  • Create product putaway warehouse tasks (optional)

  • Check material in clarification zone (optional)

processes.description:
Warehouse Internal Inspections (5OK)

Overview

During the storage of goods, a warehouse clerk may identify damage that must be checked and investigated. To follow up, the material is posted to quality inspection stock and an inspection lot is created automatically. The quality engineer inspects the material and makes a usage decision that triggers the posting of the material, for example, to unrestricted stock, to blocked stock, or to scrap.

For batch managed material, a recurring inspection can be set up based on, for example, the next inspection date. With background jobs, inspection lots can be created and inspected on a regular basis.

Key Process Flow

  • Create inspection lots via warehouse management monitor, change stock attributes or background jobs

  • Create ad-hoc warehouse task to change stock type to Q and move stock to the clarification area for inspection

  • Confirm warehouse task

  • Make usage decision

  • Repack handling units (Optional)

  • Create ad-hoc warehouse task for putaway or scrapping

  • Confirm warehouse task

Business Benefits

  • Enables quality inspection during stock handling within the warehouse

  • Enables recurring inspection of batch material – batch material inspected on a periodic basis based on characteristics such as goods receipt data or next inspection date

  • Supports sample consumption or scrap to cost center as follow-up actions

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is only relevant for customers that want to use warehouse management capabilities including storage bin management in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.

Caution: Additional organizational entities (for example, storage location, warehouse number, warehouse, and storage types) are activated as part of the warehouse management scope items.
processes.name: Warehouse Internal Inspections

processes.description:
Warehouse Internal Repacking (3BW)

Overview

With this process, you can repack stock in your warehouse. The repacking process is executed in the clarification zone. Before starting the repacking process, you can create ad hoc warehouse tasks to move the products / handling units to be repacked to the clarification zone. At the end of the process, you move the repacked products / handling units to the final bin. There are different use cases for repacking:

• Pack stock into a handling unit

• Repack stock from one handling unit into another handling unit

• Unpack stock from one handling unit onto the bin

Key Process Flow

  • Repack handling unit

  • Pack product into handling unit

  • Unpack handling unit

Business Benefits

  • Support different internal packing use cases

  • Control and record movements of goods in the warehouse

  • Map your warehouse complex in the system down to a storage bin level

  • Improve visibility and control in warehouse processes

processes.description:
Warehouse Kanban Supply into Production (3VT)

Overview

This scope item allows you to replenish material from your warehouse to production. The process starts with a notification of the empty container status in the system. By setting the Kanban status to EMPTY, the system triggers the creation of a warehouse task. A warehouse operative picks the material from the replenishment storage type, moves it to the production supply area storage bin, and confirms the task in the system. The Kanban container status is automatically set to FULL. If the production supply area is not WM-managed, the stock transfer to the production storage location is executed immediately with the confirmation. This helps to keep the manual posting effort to a minimum.

Second option: On receipt of the material, the demand source can set the Kanban container status to FULL. The warehouse task is immediately confirmed and the stock transfer to the production storage location is triggered accordingly, if required.

Key Process Flow

  • Set Kanban to empty

  • System: Create warehouse tasks for replenishment

  • Variant 1 (Status Control by Warehouse):

    • Confirm warehouse task(s)

    • System: Post goods movement (transfer stock to production storage location only if production supply area is not WM-managed)

    • System: Set Kanban to full

  • Variant 2 (Status Control by Production):

    • Set Kanban to full

    • System: Confirm warehouse tasks

    • System: Post goods movement (transfer stock to production storage location only if production supply area is not WM-managed)

Business Benefits

  • Integrate seamlessly between warehouse management and production

  • Manage stock in production on storage bin level, if required

  • Keep manual posting effort to a minimum Improve visibility and control in warehouse operations

  • Integrate seamlessly between warehouse management and production

This scope item is excluded from the default activation.

This scope item is only relevant for customers who use warehouse management capabilities in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition and want to supply material to production using Kanban Stock Transfer with Warehouse Tasks.

processes.description:
Warehouse Outbound Processing (3BS)

Overview

With this process, products are picked, packed, and sent from your warehouse. This scope item supports different outbound process scenarios. For example, you can send ordered products to external customers, return products to suppliers, and supply products to internal customers.

The process starts with an outbound delivery that is relevant for processing in the warehouse. Warehouse tasks are created based on the outbound delivery. The physical process for picking is executed and then confirmed. If packing is required, a warehouse worker packs the products into shipping handling units. Serial numbers are captured in different steps depending on whether the product is managed on documentation level (documentation serialization) or stock level (serialization in stock). Finally, the goods issue is posted.

Key Process Flow

  • Assign carrier (optional)

  • Create pick warehouse tasks and print picking lists

  • Confirm pick warehouse tasks

  • Pack goods into shipping handling units and print labels (optional)

  • Enter serial numbers for outbound delivery order (optional)

  • Set deliveries to ready for shipping (optional)

  • Check printed delivery note before goods issue (optional)

  • Print loading instruction (optional)

  • Handle loading (optional)

  • Post goods issue

Business Benefits

  • Control and record movements of products and handling units in the warehouse

  • Map your warehouse complex in the system down to storage bin level

  • Improve visibility and control in warehouse operations

  • Leverage shipping handling units including label printing during packing

  • Handle exceptions

  • Capture serial numbers during or after packing

  • Attach files (for example, pictures) to outbound delivery orders

  • Support most process steps with both app and RF support
